abstract: Improving water quality is an important goal for policymakers, yet understanding the economic benefits people receive from changes in water quality is challenging because many of the benefits are non‐market in nature. We use spatially explicit lake Secchi disk depth measures and information on over 320,000 property sales to provide the most extensive revealed preference value estimates of water clarity improvements in Canada. We find that a 10% increase in water clarity (as measured by Secchi disk depth) appreciates nearby property values by 0.56%. We do not find evidence for higher price premiums for properties located within 0–250 m of a lake compared to 250–500 m. The findings remain consistent when employing property fixed‐effect models and a series of alternative model specifications. A 10% improvement in lake water clarity in southern Ontario is estimated to yield a total benefit of $2 billion across properties with an aggregate property value of $359 billion, translating to an average benefit of $151 per household. The increase in property values could provide $31 million in additional annual municipal tax revenue to fund water quality improvement initiatives.
abstract_zh: 改善水质是政策制定者的重要目标，但理解人们从水质变化中获得的经济收益具有挑战性，因为许多收益本质上属于非市场收益。我们利用空间明确的湖泊塞氏盘深度测量数据以及超过32万宗房产销售信息，提供了加拿大迄今为止最广泛的关于水体清澈度改善的显示性偏好价值估计。我们发现，水体清澈度提高10%（以塞氏盘深度衡量）会使附近房产价值上升0.56%。我们未发现距湖泊0–250米范围内的房产相比250–500米范围内的房产存在更高价格溢价的证据。当采用房产固定效应模型及一系列替代模型设定时，这些发现仍然稳健。据估计，安大略省南部湖泊水体清澈度提高10%，将在总房产价值达3590亿美元的房产中产生20亿美元的总收益，相当于每户平均收益151美元。房产价值的上升可为水质改善倡议提供3100万美元的额外年度市政税收收入。
title: Valuing local water quality in Ontario using revealed preference data
title_zh: 利用显示性偏好数据评估安大略省地方水质价值

abstract: This study examines whether and how data intellectual property protection enhances corporate digital innovation advantage. Using Chinese listed firms from 2018 to 2024, we exploit the staggered implementation of data intellectual property pilots as a quasi-natural experiment and employ a multi-period difference-in-differences model. The results show that data intellectual property protection significantly strengthens corporate digital innovation advantage. Mechanism tests indicate that this effect operates by alleviating credit constraints and facilitating the aggregation and sharing of data knowledge. The effect is more pronounced among firms located farther from banks, firms in non-decline life-cycle stages, non-high-tech firms, and firms in regions with better-developed technology factor markets. Further analyses show that data intellectual property protection directly improves total factor productivity and operating profit growth, while stronger digital innovation advantage further amplifies these performance gains. This study provides firm-level evidence on the innovation and economic consequences of data property-rights institutions and offers policy implications for improving data property-rights systems and promoting high-quality digital innovation.

title: When data become protected assets: intellectual property protection and corporate digital innovation advantage
title_zh: 当数据成为受保护资产：知识产权保护与企业数字创新优势

abstract: This paper uses the Brexit referendum in 2016 as a quasi‐natural experiment to estimate the effect of an exogenous negative shock to globalization on executive compensation for German companies listed in the DAX and MDAX stock indices. We show that it matters whether they work for firms exporting goods or services. The main results indicate that executive compensation in firms operating in sectors that export services was negatively affected, in particular through lower variable compensation. On the contrary, executives of firms that operate in sectors exporting goods were not negatively affected overall, though they experienced a compositional change (from bonuses to equity payments). Sectoral regressions suggest that manufacturing firms successfully redirected exports from the UK to other relevant trade partners, while this was not the case in the service sector.
abstract_zh: 本文以2016年英国脱欧公投作为准自然实验，估计全球化外生负面冲击对在DAX和MDAX股票指数上市的德国公司高管薪酬的影响。我们表明，高管任职于出口商品企业还是出口服务企业，其结果存在差异。主要结果表明，在出口服务部门经营的企业中，高管薪酬受到负面影响，尤其是通过降低可变薪酬。相反，在出口商品部门经营的企业中，高管总体上并未受到负面影响，尽管其薪酬结构发生了变化（从奖金转向股权支付）。分部门回归表明，制造业企业成功地将出口从英国转向其他相关贸易伙伴，而服务业则并非如此。

abstract: This paper takes the new infrastructure special bonds (NISB) issued by Chinese local governments as the research object and explores the carbon reduction effects of new infrastructure construction (NIC) from the perspective of public investment. Using a newly constructed city-level dataset, this paper finds that NISB issuance significantly reduces carbon emissions, with this impact being more pronounced in cities with strong fiscal capacity, high industrial value-added, and effective policy coordination. On the one hand, NISB promote the penetration rate of digital technology and intelligent equipment in production, thus contributing to carbon reduction through improved production efficiency. On the other hand, NISB channel fiscal funds and social capital toward low-carbon industries, which helps to lock in lower carbon emissions over a longer period. Further evidence indicates that following the COVID-19 outbreak, local governments reoriented NISB policy priorities from a balanced focus on carbon reduction and economic growth goals toward greater emphasis on boosting economic recovery, a shift that also weakened the carbon reduction effects of NISB to some extent. This paper offers new evidence that targeted public investment can contribute to climate change mitigation, while emphasizing the short-run trade-off between long-term emission reduction and stable growth during economic downturns.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国地方政府发行的新基建专项债券（NISB）为研究对象，从公共投资视角探讨新型基础设施建设（NIC）的碳减排效应。本文利用新构建的城市级数据集发现，新基建专项债券的发行显著降低了碳排放，且这一影响在财政能力较强、工业增加值较高以及政策协调有效的城市中更为明显。一方面，新基建专项债券促进了数字技术和智能设备在生产中的渗透率，从而通过提高生产效率助力碳减排。另一方面，新基建专项债券引导财政资金和社会资本流向低碳产业，有助于在较长时期内锁定较低的碳排放。进一步证据表明，新冠疫情暴发后，地方政府将新基建专项债券的政策重点从兼顾碳减排与经济增长目标的平衡取向，转向更加侧重推动经济复苏，这一转变也在一定程度上削弱了新基建专项债券的碳减排效应。本文提供了新的证据，表明有针对性的公共投资有助于减缓气候变化，同时强调了在经济下行期间长期减排与稳定增长之间的短期权衡。

title: The carbon reduction effects of new infrastructure construction: Evidence from local government special bonds in China

abstract: This paper analyzes how civic capital shapes the relationship between government size and economic performance. Public-service provision is modeled as an O-ring technology in which each service requires the successful completion of a sequence of complementary tasks. Civic capital, proxied by generalized trust, raises task reliability and reduces costly administrative burdens, thereby increasing public-sector productivity. Embedding this mechanism in a standard exogenous-growth framework, we show that higher civicness not only shifts upward the conventional inverted-U relationship between government size and income but also shifts its peak to the right. Hence, more civic societies can sustain larger and more efficient public sectors. Evidence from a dynamic panel of 34 OECD countries (1990–2019) supports these predictions.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了公民资本如何塑造政府规模与经济绩效之间的关系。公共服务供给被建模为一种O型环技术，其中每项服务都需要一系列互补任务的顺利完成。以普遍信任为代理变量的公民资本提高了任务可靠性并降低了高昂的行政负担，从而提升了公共部门生产率。将这一机制嵌入标准的外生增长框架后，我们表明，更高的公民性不仅使政府规模与收入之间传统的倒U型关系整体上移，还使其峰值向右移动。因此，公民性更强的社会能够维持更大且更有效率的公共部门。来自34个OECD国家（1990—2019年）动态面板的证据支持了这些预测。
title: Government Size, Civic Capital and Economic Performance: An O-ring approach
title_zh: 政府规模、公民资本与经济绩效：一个O型环方法

abstract: Reliable ex ante evaluation of transportation infrastructure projects is vital for sound public investment decisions. Spatial computable general equilibrium (SCGE) models widely employ the iceberg (IB) assumption, which specifies freight costs as a fixed proportion of transported commodity values. However, this formulation abstracts from transport-sector productivity gains and their economy-wide general equilibrium effects, introducing systematic distortions into welfare appraisals. To resolve these limitations, this study develops an SCGE framework that endogenizes transportation costs by explicitly modeling transportation as an autonomous production sector. Analytical derivations establish two primary sources of welfare bias in the IB model: the theoretical impossibility of determining post-policy transportation cost rates ex ante, and the omission of general equilibrium ripple effects generated by dedicated transport activities. We formalize this discrepancy by decomposing the welfare bias into four transmission channels: goods prices, factor returns, transportation demand, and aggregate expenditure. An empirical application to the Japanese interregional economy demonstrates that the IB formulation underestimates project welfare gains by 10.4%, underscoring the necessity of structural transport modeling for robust project evaluation.
abstract_zh: 对交通基础设施项目进行可靠的事前评估，对于合理的公共投资决策至关重要。空间可计算一般均衡（SCGE）模型广泛采用冰山（IB）假设，该假设将运输成本设定为所运输商品价值的一个固定比例。然而，这种设定抽象掉了运输部门生产率提升及其在全经济范围内的一般均衡效应，从而在福利评估中引入系统性扭曲。为解决这些局限，本研究构建了一个SCGE框架，通过将运输明确建模为一个独立的生产部门，使运输成本内生化。解析推导确立了IB模型中福利偏差的两个主要来源：事前无法确定政策后运输成本率的理论不可能性，以及专门运输活动所产生的一般均衡连锁效应的遗漏。我们通过将福利偏差分解为四个传导渠道来形式化这一差异：商品价格、要素回报、运输需求和总支出。对日本区域间经济的实证应用表明，IB设定将项目福利收益低估了10.4%，凸显了结构性运输建模对于稳健项目评估的必要性。
title: Beyond the Iceberg Model: Welfare Bias from Exogenously Specified Transportation Costs in CGE Models
title_zh: 超越冰山模型：CGE模型中外生指定运输成本导致的福利偏差

abstract: Standard economic models predict that higher asset prices increase investment by relaxing firms’ borrowing limits. We find that a supply–valuation paradox can arise. The standard price channel operates, but it is overwhelmed by the contraction of the collateral stock. Using China’s sudden end to its zero-COVID-19 policy as a major supply shock, we observe that housing prices rose while housing investment collapsed during the same period. We build a model to explain this puzzle. When a supply shock reduces the physical quantity of real estate that firms can use as collateral, the total value of available collateral falls, even if the price per unit goes up. Banks care about total collateral value, so firms lose borrowing capacity and productive investment drops. Hence, if only prices had risen while quantities stayed fixed, investment would have improved. We show that reopening quickly ends the collateral shortage and, thus, is welfare improving. Fiscal policy can help if it taxes the housing sector’s profits and uses the revenue to subsidise productive firms, with the subsidy rate rising as the shortage worsens. In contrast, a lump-sum subsidy ignores the severity of the shortage, so it stimulates more demand for the same housing assets, driving prices higher without fixing the underlying collateral shortage. Thus, standard stimulus tools may be counterproductive when recessions are caused by supply shortages rather than weak demand.
abstract_zh: 标准经济模型预测，资产价格上升会通过放松企业借贷限制来增加投资。我们发现，一种供给—估值悖论可能出现。标准的价格渠道仍在发挥作用，但其效应被抵押品存量的收缩所压倒。以中国突然结束零COVID政策作为一次重大供给冲击，我们观察到同一时期内房价上涨而房地产投资崩溃。我们构建了一个模型来解释这一谜题。当供给冲击减少了企业可用作抵押品的房地产实物数量时，即使单位价格上涨，可用抵押品的总价值仍会下降。银行关注的是抵押品总价值，因此企业失去借贷能力，生产性投资下降。因此，如果只有价格上涨而数量保持不变，投资本会改善。我们表明，重新开放会迅速终结抵押品短缺，因而提升福利。财政政策若对房地产部门利润征税，并用收入补贴生产性企业，则能有所帮助，且补贴率应随短缺加剧而上升。相比之下，一次性总额补贴忽视了短缺的严重程度，因此会刺激对相同住房资产的更多需求，推高价格，却无法解决 underlying 的抵押品短缺。因此，当衰退由供给短缺而非需求疲弱引起时，标准刺激工具可能适得其反。
china_relevance_reason: 论文以中国突然结束清零政策作为核心供给冲击，研究中国房地产价格与投资、抵押品短缺及错配问题，研究对象和制度背景均为中国。
title: The cost of collateral scarcity: Asset prices and misallocation in supply crises
title_zh: 抵押品稀缺的代价：供应危机中的资产价格与错配

abstract: Financial openness can discipline macroeconomic policy, yet little is known about whether it also constrains discretionary fiscal behavior. This paper examines the effect of financial openness on fiscal volatility using a panel of 110 advanced and developing economies over 1985–2018. Fiscal volatility is measured as the variability of discretionary fiscal policy changes that are unrelated to business-cycle conditions. I find that greater financial openness is associated with lower fiscal volatility, a result that is robust to extensive checks. The stabilizing effect is stronger in advanced economies, weaker in resource-rich countries, and attenuated in the aftermath of major financial crises. I further provide evidence consistent with a market-discipline mechanism: greater financial openness is associated with stronger sovereign credit ratings and greater access to foreign financing, both of which are associated with lower fiscal volatility. Overall, the findings identify fiscal stability as an additional dimension through which international financial integration can shape macroeconomic policy.
abstract_zh: 金融开放能够约束宏观经济政策，但人们对其是否也会限制相机财政行为知之甚少。本文利用1985—2018年间110个发达经济体和发展中经济体的面板数据，考察金融开放对财政波动性的影响。财政波动性以与商业周期状况无关的相机财政政策变化的变异性来衡量。我发现，更高的金融开放度与更低的财政波动性相关，这一结果在大量稳健性检验下依然成立。这种稳定效应在发达经济体中更强，在资源丰富国家中较弱，并在重大金融危机之后有所减弱。我进一步提供了与市场约束机制相一致的证据：更高的金融开放度与更强的主权信用评级和更大的外国融资渠道相关，而这两者都与更低的财政波动性相关。总体而言，这些发现将财政稳定确定为国际金融一体化能够塑造宏观经济政策的又一维度。
title: Financial openness and fiscal volatility: The role of market discipline
title_zh: 金融开放与财政波动：市场约束的作用

abstract: Browning et al. (2013) model collective‐household economies of scale in goods consumption by having each good be partly shared, instead of each good being public or private. We modify their model to achieve simple point identification and estimation of the economies of scale of consumption of each good, and we provide a new index of household level economies of scale. Our model has a linear form, permits households of varying composition, including children, and accommodates unobserved heterogeneity in both preferences and in the economies of scale of each good. We provide estimates using Canadian Surveys of Household Spending data.
abstract_zh: Browning等人（2013）通过让每种商品部分共享，而非将每种商品完全视为公共品或私人品，来建模集体家庭在商品消费中的规模经济。我们修改了他们的模型，以实现对每种商品消费规模经济的简单点识别与估计，并提出了一种新的家庭层面规模经济指数。我们的模型具有线性形式，允许家庭构成存在差异，包括有子女的家庭，并容纳了偏好以及每种商品规模经济中不可观测的异质性。我们使用加拿大住户支出调查数据提供了估计结果。
title: Economies of Scale to Consumption in Collective Households
title_zh: 集体家庭中的消费规模经济

abstract: Satisficing choice is a well-known decision-making rule. However, as the literature shows, its predictive power is limited because identifying the underlying primitives is difficult. We consider a random satisficing model (RSM) where the decision maker is endowed with a preference, a random threshold, and a random search order. We characterize RSM with two axioms that use the concept of “virtual satisficing sets” introduced in the paper. We also show that the underlying preference can be generically identified when the distribution of search orders has full support and is known to the analyst. Further, we consider a possible generalization of the result when the analyst does not have full knowledge of the distribution of search orders, and when the stochastic search orders do not necessarily have full support.
abstract_zh: 满意化选择是一种著名的决策规则。然而，正如文献所示，其预测能力有限，因为识别其潜在基本要素较为困难。我们考虑一个随机满意化模型（RSM），其中决策者被赋予一个偏好、一个随机阈值和一个随机搜索顺序。我们利用本文引入的“虚拟满意化集”概念，以两条公理刻画了RSM。我们还表明，当搜索顺序的分布具有完全支撑且为分析者所知时，其潜在偏好可以被一般性识别。进一步，我们考虑了当分析者并不完全知晓搜索顺序的分布，以及当随机搜索顺序不一定具有完全支撑时，该结果的一种可能推广。
title: Random satisficing model: Characterization and (generic) identification
title_zh: 随机满意模型：特征刻画与（一般）识别

abstract: This paper investigates the employment effects of information and communication technology (ICT) investment across 336 Chinese regions from 2010 to 2020, employing a Bartik instrument. Results reveal that ICT investment significantly promotes overall employment growth. Although hardware-specific ICT investment exerts a substitution effect on manufacturing employment, the subsequent efficiency gains in the manufacturing sector stimulate demand expansion in downstream service industries, driving net job creation. Furthermore, the employment gains are primarily concentrated among middle-skilled workers and in regions with a higher exposure to non-routine tasks. Spatially, ICT investment generates positive spillovers for geographically proximate areas, while exerting negative spillovers on regions with similar economic scales. These findings underscore the positive contribution of ICT investment to China’s employment growth over the past decade, highlighting a distinct pattern from that observed in developed economies.
abstract_zh: 本文使用Bartik工具变量，考察了2010年至2020年间中国336个地区的信息与通信技术（ICT）投资的就业效应。结果表明，ICT投资显著促进了整体就业增长。尽管硬件类ICT投资对制造业就业产生替代效应，但制造业部门随之而来的效率提升刺激了下游服务业的需求扩张，从而推动了净就业创造。此外，就业增长主要集中在中等技能劳动者以及非routine任务暴露程度较高的地区。在空间上，ICT投资对地理邻近地区产生正向溢出效应，而对经济规模相似的地区则产生负向溢出效应。这些发现凸显了ICT投资在过去十年对中国就业增长的积极贡献，并揭示出与发达经济体所观察到的不同模式。

title: The employment effects of ICT investment: evidence from China
title_zh: 信息通信技术投资的就业效应：来自中国的证据

abstract: I study the introduction of statutory caps on executive pay ratios (pay caps) in a span-of-control economy with heterogeneous managerial talent. Managers hire fewer workers than they would in the absence of pay caps, and the marginal product of labour is not equalized among firms. The ability of the marginal manager declines. Inequality between managers and workers, and among managers, declines, but inequality among workers increases. Quantitatively, overall inequality decreases substantially, especially via a reduction in top income shares, but the GDP losses are also significant. In addition, the redistribution favours the “middle” deciles between 50 and 90, rather than the bottom 50% of the income distribution. Future work will build on this “first pass” to analyse the effect of pay caps in economies distorted by monopsony power, non-pecuniary benefits of control, and managerial rent extraction.
abstract_zh: 我研究在具有异质性管理才能的控制幅度经济中引入高管薪酬比率法定上限（薪酬上限）的影响。管理者雇佣的工人数量少于不存在薪酬上限时的水平，且劳动的边际产品在企业之间不再均等化。边际管理者的能力下降。管理者与工人之间以及管理者之间的不平等下降，但工人之间的不平等上升。在数量上，总体不平等显著下降，尤其是通过降低最高收入份额，但GDP损失也很显著。此外，再分配有利于第50至90百分位之间的“中间”十分位数，而非收入分布中最低的50%。未来的工作将在此基础上进一步分析在买方垄断势力、控制权非货币收益和管理者租金抽取所扭曲的经济中薪酬上限的影响。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Macroeconomic Implications of Executive Pay Caps*,†
title_zh: 高管薪酬上限的宏观经济影响

abstract: Sportsbooks offer promotional ``free bets'' that return profits if the bets win, but not the stake provided. These bets can be hedged to produce guaranteed profits. This paper shows how to value the guaranteed profit from these stake-not-returned free bets under a simple constant-margin pricing rule in which sportsbooks, on average, keep a fraction m of the money staked. The guaranteed hedged value is a nonlinear function of the free bet's probability of winning, reaching a maximum when this probability is the square root of m time 1-m. Empirical evidence from odds on tennis bets confirms this prediction.
abstract_zh: 体育博彩公司提供促销性的“免费投注”，若投注获胜则返还利润，但不返还所提供的本金。这些投注可以通过对冲产生保证利润。本文展示了在一种简单的固定利润率定价规则下，如何对这些不返还本金的免费投注所生成的保证利润进行估值；在该规则下，体育博彩公司平均保留投注金额的一个比例 m。对冲后的保证价值是免费投注获胜概率的非线性函数，并在该概率等于 m 乘以 1 减 m 的平方根时达到最大值。来自网球投注赔率的经验证据证实了这一预测。
title: The Economics of Free Bets
title_zh: 免费投注的经济学

abstract: Informal employment, and the resulting lack of social insurance coverage, remains widespread in low- and middle-income countries. This paper contributes to the debate on the determinants of informality by estimating workers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for a formal job using a sample of 4997 Brazilian dependent workers. On average, workers are willing to forgo 15.1% of their wages for a signed work card, with higher WTP among formal and highly educated workers. Predicted eligibility for non-contributory social assistance lowers WTP, while predicted eligibility for contributory social insurance increases it. A simple calculation suggests that workers’ WTP may not fully offset employer contributions if passed on through lower wages. Providing additional information on formality raises WTP, but mainly among those already having a higher valuation of formality.
abstract_zh: 非正规就业以及由此导致的社会保险覆盖缺失，在低收入和中等收入国家仍然普遍存在。本文利用4997名巴西受雇劳动者的样本，估计劳动者为获得一份正规工作所愿意支付的水平，从而为关于非正规性决定因素的争论作出贡献。平均而言，劳动者愿意放弃其工资的15.1%，以换取一份签订劳动合同的工作，且正规就业者和受教育程度较高的劳动者的支付意愿更高。预测可获得非缴费型社会救助会降低支付意愿，而预测可获得缴费型社会保险则会提高支付意愿。一个简单计算表明，如果雇主缴费通过更低工资转嫁，劳动者的支付意愿可能无法完全抵消雇主缴费。提供关于正规性的额外信息会提高支付意愿，但主要是在那些原本对正规性赋予更高价值的人群中。
title: Do workers value formal jobs? Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 工人是否重视正规就业？来自巴西的证据

abstract: Colombia is one of the world’s most biodiverse countries, home to over 10% of the planet’s biodiversity. Much of this richness is found in the Amazon biome, which spans over 43% of the country’s land surface. Despite its ecological importance, the region is subject to growing threats from deforestation, leading to loss of biodiversity and degradation of ecosystem services. Key drivers of this deforestation include socio-environmental conflicts, such as land conversion, coca cultivation, and illegal mining, all of which are compounded by Colombia’s longstanding internal armed conflict. Socioeconomic conditions in local communities further reinforce these drivers, yet limited access to reliable data constrains understanding and has led to a gap in literature. This study examines the links between socioeconomic factors, socio-environmental conflicts, and deforestation across the Amazon biome in Colombia. Using different sources of information, we construct a broad set of indicators and use econometric methods and machine learning (ML) techniques to identify the main drivers of forest loss. The results show that while the contribution of coca cultivation to deforestation has declined, land grabbing has emerged as a leading driver. Mining causes significant disturbances to the Amazon biome, but its link to deforestation is marginal. Other consistent predictors include poverty and the presence of basic trails and roads. The analysis also confirms that the northwestern zone remains the most threatened subregion, and that forest conservation is positively associated with the presence of Indigenous communities.
abstract_zh: 哥伦比亚是世界上生物多样性最丰富的国家之一，拥有地球超过10%的生物多样性。其中大部分丰富性集中于亚马孙生物群系，该区域覆盖了该国超过43%的陆地面积。尽管具有重要的生态意义，该地区仍面临日益加剧的森林砍伐威胁，导致生物多样性丧失和生态系统服务退化。森林砍伐的主要驱动因素包括社会环境冲突，如土地用途转换、古柯种植和非法采矿，而哥伦比亚长期存在的内部武装冲突又加剧了这些问题。当地社区的社会经济状况进一步强化了这些驱动因素，但可靠数据获取受限制约了相关认识，并导致文献中存在研究空白。本研究考察了哥伦比亚亚马孙生物群系中社会经济因素、社会环境冲突与森林砍伐之间的联系。我们利用不同来源的信息构建了一套广泛的指标，并运用计量经济学方法和机器学习（ML）技术来识别森林丧失的主要驱动因素。结果表明，尽管古柯种植对森林砍伐的贡献有所下降，但土地掠夺已成为主要驱动因素。采矿对亚马孙生物群系造成显著干扰，但其与森林砍伐的联系较为微弱。其他一致的预测因素包括贫困以及基本小径和道路的存在。分析还证实，西北部地区仍是受威胁最严重的次区域，而森林保护与土著社区的存在呈正相关。
title: Deforestation in the Colombian amazon biome: socioeconomic and socio-environmental conflict drivers
title_zh: 哥伦比亚亚马逊生物群落的森林砍伐：社会经济与社会环境冲突驱动因素

abstract: How do social norms shape the intergenerational allocation of land, particularly regarding gender equity? We combine experimental and administrative data from Senegal with a model of social interactions to study how parental preferences and community norms influence land allocation to sons and daughters. A choice experiment that randomizes land allocations and normative cues reveals that parents are more responsive to community norms when allocating land to daughters—a pattern subsequently borne out in administrative records. Simulations show that this asymmetry generates multiple equilibria in land allocation to daughters but not sons, so even modest shifts in perceived norms can meaningfully reduce gender gaps.
abstract_zh: 社会规范如何塑造土地的代际分配，尤其是在性别公平方面？我们结合塞内加尔的实验数据和行政数据与社会互动模型，研究父母偏好和社区规范如何影响对儿子和女儿的土地分配。一项随机化土地分配和规范性提示的选择实验表明，父母在向女儿分配土地时对社区规范更为敏感——这一模式随后在行政记录中得到证实。模拟显示，这种不对称性在向女儿分配土地时产生多重均衡，而在向儿子分配土地时则不会，因此即使感知规范发生适度变化，也能显著缩小性别差距。
title: Shifting Grounds: Social Norms and the Intergenerational Transmission of Wealth
title_zh: 变迁的根基：社会规范与财富的代际传递

abstract: The building sector accounts for nearly one-third of global final energy use. A range of energy efficiency policies can help reduce energy consumption in the sector. These policies include building energy codes, which improve energy efficiency in new buildings, as well as retrofit programs and whole-building performance standards, which address efficiency of existing buildings. In this study, we use the Global Change Analysis Model to assess the impacts of these policies on building energy use and other key outcomes globally and across regions. Additionally, we explore how compliance rates influence policy effectiveness and examine the interactions between building efficiency policies, socioeconomic development, and related policy issues. Our study shows that energy demand from the building sector will rise significantly through 2050, absent policies. Socioeconomic development and population gains will be the dominant contributors to this growth. The sector’s energy use could be considerably reduced by implementing effective building efficiency policies. We find that universal adoption and high compliance of advanced building efficiency policies could reduce building energy use by approximately 44% by 2050. Low policy compliance, however, could reduce their effectiveness by nearly half. Furthermore, the impacts of these policies vary by region. Our study indicates that emerging economies in South Asia and Africa would benefit the most from policies targeting new buildings, with gross savings at nearly 1% of GDP in 2050. Meanwhile, China and countries in Europe and North America would benefit the most from a combination of policies addressing both new and existing buildings.
abstract_zh: 建筑部门占全球终端能源消费的近三分之一。一系列能效政策有助于降低该部门的能源消耗。这些政策包括建筑能效规范，其可提升新建建筑的能效，以及改造项目和整体建筑性能标准，其针对既有建筑的能效。在本研究中，我们使用全球变化分析模型评估这些政策对全球及各区域建筑能源使用及其他关键结果的影响。此外，我们探讨合规率如何影响政策有效性，并考察建筑能效政策、社会经济发展及相关政策问题之间的相互作用。我们的研究表明，在缺乏政策的情况下，建筑部门的能源需求到2050年将显著上升。社会经济发展和人口增长将是这一增长的主要驱动因素。通过实施有效的建筑能效政策，该部门的能源使用可大幅减少。我们发现，若先进建筑能效政策得到普遍采用且合规率高，到2050年可使建筑能源使用减少约44%。然而，政策合规率低可能使其有效性降低近一半。此外，这些政策的影响因区域而异。我们的研究表明，南亚和非洲的新兴经济体将从针对新建建筑的政策中获益最多，到2050年总节约额接近GDP的1%。与此同时，中国以及欧洲和北美国家将从同时针对新建和既有建筑的政策组合中获益最多。
china_relevance_reason: 研究为全球及多区域建筑能效政策评估，中国仅作为受益区域之一被顺带提及，并非核心研究对象、数据或制度背景。
title: Evaluating the global economy-wide impact of energy efficiency policies in buildings
title_zh: 评估建筑能效政策对全球经济的影响

abstract: We evaluate the short- and long-run effects of different growth-enhancing policy measures of realistic size in the euro area using a calibrated New Keynesian model with endogenous growth driven by private-sector R&D accumulation. We simulate a 0.5 percentage-point increase in subsidies to R&D, a 1 percent rise in public investment in infrastructure (both as a share of initial GDP), and pro-competition reforms that reduce firms’ markups by 1 percentage point. The latter two measures are assumed to stimulate R&D. Our results show that subsidies to R&D have the largest effect on long-run growth (0.6 percentage points), while public investment and pro-competition reforms increase growth by 0.3 and 0.2 percentage points, respectively. All measures exert mildly negative effects on inflation in the short run through their positive impact on aggregate supply. Overall, policies that support R&D play a key role in strengthening long-run growth.
abstract_zh: 我们使用一个校准的新凯恩斯模型，评估欧元区不同规模现实的促增长政策措施在短期和长期的影响，该模型具有由私人部门研发积累驱动的内生增长。我们模拟研发补贴增加0.5个百分点、基础设施公共投资增加1%（二者均以初始GDP的份额计），以及将企业加成率降低1个百分点的促进竞争改革。后两项措施被假定会刺激研发。我们的结果表明，研发补贴对长期增长的影响最大（0.6个百分点），而公共投资和促进竞争改革分别使增长提高0.3和0.2个百分点。所有措施在短期内都通过其对总供给的积极影响而对通胀产生轻微负面影响。总体而言，支持研发的政策在增强长期增长方面发挥关键作用。
title: Macroeconomic effects of growth policies in the euro area
title_zh: 欧元区增长政策的宏观经济效应

abstract: Sufficient dimension reduction is an important branch of statistical learning, which performs an optimal projection of covariates under a supervised learning framework. Most of the existing sufficient dimension reduction algorithms require strict restrictions on the distribution of models, making them sensitive to heavy-tailed predictors and outliers. In this article, we propose a novel method called Sliced Inverse Kendall’s tau Estimation (SIKE) designed for analyzing heavy-tailed, elliptically distributed and high-dimensional data that find wide application, especially in finance and economics. Compared with other existing methods, SIKE does not require computing median or conditional median, thus imposes milder conditions on the method and increases the precision of estimation. Furthermore, a remedial algorithm is introduced in discouraging situation, which enhances the general adaptability of our method. We investigate the theoretical properties of SIKE as the dimension p diverges with sample size n. Extensive simulation studies show that SIKE performs significantly well for various scenarios. Analyses of asset pricing data and housing data also demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.
title: High-Dimensional Sliced Inverse Kendall’s Tau Estimation for Heavy-Tailed Data
title_zh: 高维重尾数据下的切片逆Kendall's Tau估计

abstract: Many transfer programs target women based on evidence that mothers are more likely than fathers to allocate resources toward child welfare. However, findings on gendered impacts remain mixed—likely because parental knowledge, preferences, and household decision-making roles differ across contexts. In this study, we experimentally vary the intrahousehold informational context itself through a randomized controlled trial in rural Ethiopia. Specifically, employing a factorial design, we cross-randomize two key dimensions: (1) which parent receives nutrition behavior change communication (BCC)—neither, mother only, or both; and (2) which parent receives a household food voucher—mother or father. We find that, pooled across settings in which fathers do not receive BCC, vouchers assigned to mothers generate larger improvements in child-feeding practices than vouchers assigned to fathers. The largest effects occur when mothers receive both BCC and the voucher. This maternal advantage attenuates and is no longer detectable when fathers also receive BCC. We provide suggestive evidence that when mothers have both a knowledge advantage and control over resources, they are better able to mobilize greater intrahousehold support. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for intrahousehold contexts, not just recipient gender, when designing nutrition interventions
abstract_zh: 许多转移支付项目以女性为目标，其依据是有证据表明母亲比父亲更可能将资源用于儿童福利。然而，关于性别化影响的研究结果仍不一致——这可能是因为父母的知识、偏好以及家庭决策角色因情境而异。在本研究中，我们通过埃塞俄比亚农村的一项随机对照试验，对家庭内部信息情境本身进行了实验性变化。具体而言，我们采用析因设计，对两个关键维度进行交叉随机化：（1）哪一方父母接受营养行为改变沟通（BCC）——双方均不接受、仅母亲接受，或父母双方均接受；（2）哪一方父母接受家庭食品券——母亲或父亲。我们发现，在父亲不接受BCC的情境中汇总来看，分配给母亲的食品券在改善儿童喂养实践方面比分配给父亲的食品券产生更大的效果。当母亲同时接受BCC和食品券时，效果最大。当父亲也接受BCC时，这种母亲优势减弱且不再可检测。我们提供了提示性证据表明，当母亲同时拥有知识优势和资源控制权时，她们能够更好地调动更多家庭内部支持。这些发现凸显了在设计营养干预措施时，不仅应考虑受益者性别，还应考虑家庭内部情境的重要性。
title: Beyond targeting women: Intrahousehold contexts and the effectiveness of food vouchers
title_zh: 超越针对女性：家庭内部背景与食品券的有效性

abstract: This paper examines whether and how the peer information environment – generated by peer firms’ disclosures and by the information intermediaries covering them – affects the CEO’s delegation of decision rights to division managers (DMs). Using an international survey dataset, I measure within-firm delegation of decision-making over capital investment, human capital investment, investment in new products, and sales. I find that CEOs delegate more to managers of divisions in country-industries with richer peer information environments. Cross-sectional tests highlight three underlying channels. Specifically, the results suggest that peer information (i) helps the CEO acquire information to reduce potential information disadvantages relative to DMs (CEO learning), (ii) mitigates CEO-DM agency frictions (agency mitigation), and (iii) provides DMs with relevant information to make better decisions (DM learning). While CEO learning reduces delegation, agency mitigation and DM learning increase it. These findings provide evidence that information about peers influences the internal organization of firms.
title: Managerial delegation within firms and peer information environment
title_zh: 企业内的管理授权与同行信息环境

abstract: Digital platforms that connect customers with service providers often monetize by selling customer leads to interested providers. Examples include Bark, Google Local Services, HomeAdvisor, Modernize, Porch, and Thumbtack. This paper develops a game-theoretic model to analyze how lead pricing affects customer and provider welfare. When the platform raises the fee-per-lead for a customer-type, those customers—conditional on receiving the same number of provider quotes—are quoted lower prices. However, if the fee is sufficiently high, providers purchase fewer of these leads, which can reduce the number of quotes and diminish customer surplus. To maximize social welfare, a simple policy that sets a market-clearing fee-per-lead for each customer-type guarantees at least [Formula: see text] of the first-best welfare and at least [Formula: see text] of the welfare under the welfare-optimal fees. The first-best outcome can be achieved by subsidizing providers for each job well done, so that experienced providers with cheaper sources of leads do not exit the platform. Understanding these welfare trade-offs can help platforms design policies that support balanced marketplace growth and preserve a sustainable revenue stream. This paper was accepted by Srikanth Jagabathula, market design, platform, and demand analytics. abstract: The digital and green transitions are reshaping regional development strategies across Europe. However, little is known about the impact of ICT sector agglomeration on regional eco-efficiency. Moving beyond the common assumption of linear effects, we investigate whether the relationship is non-linear and how it varies along the core–periphery gradient. We measure eco-efficiency through the Global Malmquist-Luenberger index, which considers both economic output and CO2 emissions, and estimate a two-step difference GMM model for 173 European NUTS 2 regions between 2008 and 2019. Our results reveal an inverted U-shaped relationship: moderate agglomeration enhances eco-efficiency, whereas excessive concentration reduces it, signalling congestion diseconomies. Peripheral and semi-central regions benefit most, while core regions appear to have surpassed their optimal concentration. Renewable energy and environmental policies further shape these outcomes. Thus, the impact of ICT agglomeration depends critically on regional characteristics, calling for place-based policies that integrate digital development with environmental sustainability.
title: Beyond productivity: Does ICT agglomeration drive regional eco-efficiency?
title_zh: 超越生产率：信息通信技术集聚能否驱动区域生态效率？

abstract: We study optimal fiscal policy in a small open economy within a currency union subject to downward nominal wage rigidity. Government spending is divided between public consumption and productive public investment, with investment accumulating into public capital subject to time-to-build. We characterize the Ramsey allocation when the policymaker jointly chooses consumption taxes, public consumption, and public investment. Fiscal instruments operate through distinct but complementary margins: consumption taxes mitigate unemployment distortions when wage rigidity binds, while spending composition provides an additional intertemporal stabilization margin. In particular, state contingent public investment reallocates non-tradable resources over time, smoothing private consumption and attenuating relative price fluctuations with limited contemporaneous distortions. Calibrating the model to France, we find that coordinated fiscal policy substantially reduces unemployment risk and generates measurable welfare gains relative to regimes that rely only on taxes or keep government spending composition fixed. The results are robust across country re-calibrations for Greece, Italy, and Spain, as well as in extensions with government production, alternative time-to-build horizons, public capital adjustment costs, preference parameters, wage rigidity, and bond holding costs.
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Optimal Size and Composition of Government Spending in Small Open Economies
title_zh: 小型开放经济体政府支出的最优规模与构成

abstract: The rapid development of the digital economy has shifted attention from expanding digital industries towards the integration of digital technologies into traditional production systems. However, existing measures based on digital industry scale, proxy indicators, or composite indices may not adequately capture the structural penetration of digital technologies across inter-industry production networks. To address this limitation, this study develops an input-output accounting framework integrating RAS-based structural updating, digital input identification, and value-added decomposition. Using this framework, we construct a provincial input-output dataset for 30 Chinese provinces from 2007 to 2022 and measure the scale and evolution of industrial digitalization. The results show sustained expansion and structural embedding of digital technologies in China’s production system. The tertiary sector exhibits the highest level and fastest growth, followed by the secondary sector, while the primary sector remains less digitalized. Spatially, regional concentration coexists with broader diffusion: advanced provinces remain leaders, while cross-provincial disparities gradually narrow. These findings highlight the cumulative, network-based nature of industrial digitalization and demonstrate the value of continuous input-output accounting for capturing its temporal, sectoral, and regional dynamics. The framework provides a consistent measurement infrastructure for data-constrained environments. The results reflect structural penetration and dynamic evolution rather than causal effects.

abstract: Automation has become a central driver of corporate operational transformation, yet its implications for firms’ exposure to aggregate economic shocks remain unexplored. Utilizing a panel of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2000 to 2024, we find a negative association between automation penetration and systematic risk across a series of robustness checks. The decline in systematic risk can be attributed to the reduced labour cost rigidity and enhanced production flexibility entailed by automation. Furthermore, we document risk-mitigating effects among industry and provincial peers. Overall, our findings highlight a risk dimension of corporate technological transformation that automation is not only an operational technology but also a potential means of reducing firms’ exposure to market-wide shocks.

title: Whether and how automation mitigates firm’s risk?

abstract: This paper asks whether the 2011 Brisbane flood reshaped not only realized employment outcomes but also workers’ perceived employment security. Using panel data from the Australian HILDA Survey for 2005–2015 and a difference-in-differences design comparing flood-exposed Brisbane regions with other Australian metropolitan areas, the analysis documents three findings. First, labour-force participation and employment each fell by roughly two percentage points with no detectable rise in unemployment, pointing to labour-force withdrawal rather than active search. Second, distribution regressions show that earnings losses concentrate in the lower tail and weekly hours polarize around the full-time margin, patterns masked by mean estimates. Third, perceived unemployment risk rose and job-security satisfaction fell ahead of the realized declines, and within-person variation in perceived risk predicts subsequent movement out of employment and the labour force. Effects concentrate among workers in non-teleworkable occupations, among the youngest and oldest workers, and among low-wage workers with weaker baseline attachment, consistent with temporary worksite disruption rather than weaker local demand. Headline unemployment statistics therefore understate the full burden of post-disaster labour-market adjustment.
title: Beyond job loss: how a flood reshapes perceived employment security and labour-market adjustment
title_zh: 超越失业：洪水如何重塑就业安全感与劳动力市场调整

abstract: I study the impact of locust swarms on secondary education in Ethiopia. Combining high-resolution spatial data on locust swarm activity with administrative records from secondary schools, I use a difference-in-differences event-study design to identify the causal effects of locust shocks. I find that locust shocks reduce secondary school enrollment and completion by approximately 9.1% and 9.5%, respectively, while increasing the secondary school dropout rate by about 2.9 percentage points. These effects are particularly pronounced in remote and highly agriculture-dependent woredas. Further analysis provides suggestive evidence that these educational disruptions are associated with agricultural income losses, increases in local food prices, and declines in junior secondary school enrollment and completion. These findings highlight how biological disasters can disrupt educational progress in developing countries.
