abstract: We estimate how strongly job seekers value wages and job benefits, how well informed they are about compensation differences across employers, and how much they update their beliefs when shown such information. In a field experiment, we randomly embed wage and benefit information from an employer-review platform on job ads for 265,000 users of a Swiss job-board network. The revealed-preference estimates suggest that a 1% higher posted wage increases clicks to view and engage with the ad by 0.4%. A conceptual framework decomposes this elasticity into preferences, prior knowledge, and belief updating, which we identify through a belief-elicitation experiment with users from the same job boards. We find that job seekers underestimate wage differences across jobs by half, know little about benefit differences, and update beliefs only partially. Accounting for these information frictions, the implied own-wage elasticity of applications is 2.5–2.9. Among the twelve benefits shown across the experiment, job seekers value four significantly: a company car (10% of wages), work from home (8%), firm-sponsored childcare (6%), and a parking spot (4%). The average position offers benefits worth 11% of wages. Because higher-paying jobs offer more benefits, inequality in total compensation exceeds wage inequality.
title: Job Seekers’ Beliefs and Preferences over Wages and Benefits: Experimental Evidence from Online Job Boards
title_zh: 求职者对工资和福利的信念与偏好：来自在线招聘平台的实验证据

abstract: Despite rising levels of Global Value Chains (GVC) integration in several emerging and developing economies, the latter failed to experience a significant structural change. Thus, this paper examines how participating in global supply chains can have implications on labour reallocation in the economy, and to what extent technological advances can alter this effect. To do that, we use the EORA database and calculate structural change variables. Moreover, we control for the endogeneity between these two variables. Our main findings show that overall, global value chains participation has an insignificant effect on structural change. This result holds for different measures of GVC (backward and forward) and of structural change (static and dynamic). Several mechanisms explain the missing link between GVC and structural change, namely their inability to create enough jobs, the increase in capital‐intensive industries, the dominance of natural resources, and the skill‐biased technological change.
title:
The Missing Link: When
                    GVC
                    Does Not Matter for Structural Change
title_zh: 缺失的环节：当全球价值链对结构转型无关紧要时

abstract: We investigate how information about relative performance shapes goal setting and subsequent performance. Combining a field experiment in a university course with a complementary laboratory experiment, we exogenously vary whether individuals receive baseline relative-performance feedback before or after setting non-binding goals. We document that uninformed individuals anchor goals primarily on subjective, often inaccurate beliefs. Providing information systematically corrects these distortions: individuals who underestimate their relative ability revise their goals upward, whereas overestimators adjust their targets downward. However, the effect of information on performance is limited – it only improves performance for underestimators in the field experiment. To explore the underlying mechanism, we leverage laboratory evidence to examine voluntary goal resetting. We find that delayed feedback affects final goals only when individuals reset them. Accordingly, treatment differences in final goals are substantially attenuated for underestimators but remain sizable for overestimators. Once this goal-adjustment process is accounted for, upward revisions among underestimators improve performance, whereas downward revisions among overestimators reduce challenge and impair ultimate performance.
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: Information, goal setting and performance: Experimental evidence
title_zh: 信息、目标设定与绩效：实验证据

abstract: The hold-up problem plays a central role in organizational and institutional economics. According to standard theory, an investor may have insufficient incentives to invest in a relationship with a trading partner when the investor anticipates that in future negotiations the trading partner might behave opportunistically, so the investor's costs might not be recouped. In a prominent paper-and-pencil experiment, Ellingsen and Johannesson (2004a) have shown that communication can mitigate the hold-up problem. They allow either the investor or the trading partner to send a single text message to the other player. In order to study the robustness of their findings, we replicate their setup in an online experiment, allowing for a larger number of observations and a different subject pool. Moreover, we extend the original setup by adding a treatment with bilateral communication in order to find out whether or not the possibility of arguing back and forth can further alleviate the hold-up problem.
abstract_zh: 套牢问题在组织与制度经济学中居于核心地位。根据标准理论，当投资者预期在未来谈判中交易伙伴可能采取机会主义行为、从而导致其成本无法收回时，投资者可能缺乏足够激励去投资于与交易伙伴的关系。在一篇著名的纸笔实验中，Ellingsen和Johannesson（2004a）表明沟通可以缓解套牢问题。他们允许投资者或交易伙伴中的一方给另一方发送一条文本信息。为研究其发现的稳健性，我们在在线实验中复制了他们的实验设置，从而获得更大的观测样本量和不同的被试群体。此外，我们通过增加一个双向沟通处理扩展了原始设置，以考察来回争论的可能性是否能够进一步缓解套牢问题。
title: The Hold-Up Problem and Communication: Experimental Evidence
title_zh: 敲竹杠问题与沟通：实验证据

abstract: Inflation-linked bonds (ILBs) are indexed to official consumer prices, but the inflation exposure of long-horizon investors may differ from that index. We study how this "real basis risk" shapes optimal allocations to nominal government bonds, ILBs, and equities for investors resident in Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and the United States. We document substantial cross-country heterogeneity in hedge effectiveness and optimal portfolios and show that real basis risk and its covariance with inflation determine the substitution between nominal bonds and ILBs. The welfare benefits of access to each asset class differ markedly across countries. The results imply that inflation risk persists over long horizons, despite investments in ILBs.
abstract_zh: 通胀挂钩债券（ILBs）与官方消费者价格指数挂钩，但长期投资者的通胀敞口可能不同于该指数。我们研究了这种“实际基差风险”如何影响德国、荷兰、英国和美国居民投资者对名义政府债券、ILBs和股票的最优配置。我们记录了对冲有效性和最优组合存在显著的跨国异质性，并表明实际基差风险及其与通胀的协方差决定了名义债券与ILBs之间的替代关系。获取各类资产所带来的福利收益在各国之间存在显著差异。结果表明，尽管投资于ILBs，通胀风险在长期内依然持续存在。
title: Real Basis Risk and Long-Horizon Inflation Hedging
title_zh: 实际基差风险与长期通胀对冲

abstract: Retirement behavior in the U.S. exhibits two well-documented patterns: most individuals claim Social Security benefits early, before reaching their full retirement age, and retirees decumulate their assets more slowly than predicted by standard life-cycle models. This paper provides experimental evidence that these patterns emerge even in a controlled individual decision-making environment where early claiming and slow decumulation are not optimal. In a baseline treatment calibrated to current U.S. Social Security rules, participants display both early claiming and slower-than-optimal asset decumulation. Replacing larger annuities with lump-sum incentives in two alternative treatments, as has been proposed by the U.S. Congress, accelerates asset decumulation but does not lead to delayed claiming. These findings generalize from a convenience student sample to an older sample aged 45–55 and broadly resemble the observed behavior of similarly situated respondents in the Health and Retirement Study. We show that a wealth-preservation motive can jointly generate early claiming and slow asset decumulation, consistent with the experimental evidence.
abstract_zh: 美国退休行为呈现出两种有充分文献记载的模式：大多数人在达到完全退休年龄之前就提前申领社会保障福利，而退休人员资产消耗的速度慢于标准生命周期模型的预测。本文提供了实验证据，表明即使在受控的个体决策环境中——提前申领和缓慢消耗资产并非最优选择——这些模式依然会出现。在依据当前美国社会保障规则校准的基准处理组中，参与者同时表现出提前申领和慢于最优水平的资产消耗。在两个替代处理组中，用一次性给付激励替代较大额年金——正如美国国会所提议的那样——会加速资产消耗，但不会导致延迟申领。这些发现从便利的学生样本推广到45至55岁的年长样本，并与健康与退休研究中处境相似的受访者的实际行为大体相似。我们表明，财富保全动因能够同时产生提前申领和缓慢的资产消耗，这与实验证据相一致。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Early Social Security Claiming and Slow Asset Decumulation: Experimental Evidence
title_zh: 提前领取社会保障与资产缓慢消耗：实验证据

abstract: Addressing climate change requires individual behavioral shifts and a deep understanding of its impacts, yet the role of information and communication technologies (ICT), a powerful driver of social movements and cultural shifts, in shaping climate change literacy remains underexplored. This study addresses a critical gap by exploring how ICT, particularly mobile Internet connectivity, influences climate change literacy in Africa. I provide the first systematic evidence on the impact of mobile Internet connectivity on climate change literacy by exploiting variations in peer-based Internet connectivity in an instrumental variable strategy. Using newly georeferenced individual-level data on climate change literacy from over 42,000 respondents across 31 African countries, I show that mobile Internet connectivity has a modest yet robust effect on climate literacy, raising it by approximately 0.57 points for a typical adopter. Heterogeneity analysis shows that mobile Internet access primarily enhances the knowledge-based dimensions of climate literacy, particularly climate awareness and understanding, while also improving risk perceptions to a lesser extent. This suggests that mobile Internet contributes to climate literacy mainly by expanding access to factual information and knowledge about climate change. Suggestive evidence reveals that Internet connectivity can help close climate-related information gaps, among socio-economically disadvantaged groups, such as women, farmers, and those without formal education. Although Internet connectivity increases the frequency of using Internet and social media for news, there is no strong evidence that these platforms serve as channels linking Internet connectivity to climate literacy.
abstract_zh: 应对气候变化需要个体行为的转变以及对其影响的深刻理解，然而，作为社会运动和文化变迁的强大驱动力，信息与通信技术（ICT）在塑造气候变化素养方面的作用仍未得到充分探讨。本研究通过探究ICT，特别是移动互联网连接，如何影响非洲的气候变化素养，填补了一个关键空白。我利用基于同伴的互联网连接差异，采用工具变量策略，首次提供了移动互联网连接对气候变化素养影响的系统性证据。使用覆盖31个非洲国家、超过42,000名受访者的新地理参照个体层面气候变化素养数据，我表明移动互联网连接对气候素养具有适度但稳健的影响，使典型采用者的气候素养提高约0.57分。异质性分析显示，移动互联网接入主要增强气候素养的知识型维度，尤其是气候意识和理解，同时也在较小程度上改善风险感知。这表明移动互联网主要通过扩大对气候变化事实信息和知识的获取来促进气候素养。提示性证据表明，互联网连接有助于缩小社会经济弱势群体（如女性、农民和未受过正规教育者）中与气候相关的信息差距。尽管互联网连接提高了使用互联网和社交媒体获取新闻的频率，但没有强有力的证据表明这些平台是连接互联网连接与气候素养的渠道。
title: Mobile internet connectivity and climate change literacy in Africa
title_zh: 非洲移动互联网连接与气候变化素养

abstract: How do early-life economic shocks that do not directly affect human biology shape long-term development outcomes? While a large body of work documents persistent effects of early-life exposure to health crises, famines, and natural disasters, much less is known about shocks that operate through economic disruption. This study addresses this gap by examining the long-term effects of the Cocoa Swollen Shoot Virus Disease (CSSVD), an agricultural epidemic that devastated cocoa production in the Gold Coast (now Ghana) during the 1940s. Combining historical data on climatically suitable cocoa-growing areas with georeferenced household survey data, I exploit variation in exposure across birth timing and space to estimate the epidemic’s long-term effects. The results show that exposure during early childhood and school-going years led to substantial and persistent human capital deficits. Individuals exposed during early childhood lost about one year of schooling and were 8.5 percentage points (pp) less likely to obtain formal education, while those exposed during school-going years lost about 0.8 years of schooling and were 7.0 pp less likely to obtain formal education. Exposure is also associated with worse health outcomes, increasing morbidity by 6.2–8.5 pp and disability by 5–7.5 pp. In contrast, there is no systematic evidence of long-term effects on employment type or labor supply. Evidence on potential mechanisms points to both educational and occupational channels. Conditional on ever attending school, exposed individuals completed fewer years of schooling and were more likely to have incomplete primary education, indicating disruptions to both school progression and initial access to schooling. In addition, exposed individuals are more likely to work in the agricultural sector in adulthood, consistent with reduced educational attainment having narrowed their occupational options. These findings demonstrate that industry-specific economic shocks can generate long-term human capital deficits, even in the absence of direct biological exposure.
abstract_zh: 不直接作用于人类生物学的早期经济冲击如何塑造长期发展结果？尽管大量研究记录了生命早期暴露于健康危机、饥荒和自然灾害的持久影响，但对通过经济中断起作用的冲击却知之甚少。本研究通过考察可可 swollen shoot 病毒病（CSSVD）的长期影响来填补这一空白，该农业流行病在20世纪40年代摧毁了黄金海岸（今加纳）的可可生产。我将气候适宜可可种植区的历史数据与地理参照的家庭调查数据相结合，利用出生时间和空间上暴露程度的差异来估计该流行病的长期影响。结果表明，在幼儿期和就学年龄暴露于该冲击导致了显著且持久的人力资本赤字。在幼儿期暴露的个体损失了约一年学校教育，获得正规教育的可能性低8.5个百分点（pp），而在就学年龄暴露的个体损失了约0.8年学校教育，获得正规教育的可能性低7.0个百分点。暴露还与更差的健康结果相关，使发病率增加6.2–8.5个百分点，残疾率增加5–7.5个百分点。相比之下，没有系统性证据表明其对就业类型或劳动供给具有长期影响。关于潜在机制的证据指向教育渠道和职业渠道。在曾经入学的条件下，暴露个体完成的学校教育年限更少，且更可能未完成小学教育，表明学校 progression 和初始入学机会均受到干扰。此外，暴露个体在成年后更可能从事农业部门工作，这与教育程度降低缩小了其职业选择相一致。这些发现表明，即使没有直接的生物学暴露，特定行业的经济冲击也能产生长期人力资本赤字。
title: Early-life adversity and long-term outcomes: evidence from the cocoa swollen shoot virus outbreak in the Gold Coast
title_zh: 早期生活逆境与长期结果：来自黄金海岸可可肿枝病毒爆发的证据

abstract: Using new consumer-panel data across multiple grocery retailers, I estimate that an additional SNAP dollar raises food-at-home spending by 48 cents (s.e. 6 cents). This multi-retailer estimate is broadly in line with the 59-cent estimate in Hastings and Shapiro (2018), reinforcing evidence that SNAP benefits are non-fungible. Linking food-at-home and food-away-from-home purchases to nutritional data, I find that SNAP substantially increases calorie purchases but has little effect on nutritional composition per calorie. A behavioral welfare calibration implies an efficiency cost of in-kind provision of 12–14 cents per SNAP dollar; because this calculation is highly sensitive to the MPC, pinning down the parameter is quantitatively important.
abstract_zh: 利用多家杂货零售商的新消费者面板数据，我估计每增加1美元SNAP补助会使家庭食品支出增加48美分（标准误为6美分）。这一多零售商估计值与Hastings和Shapiro（2018）的59美分估计值大体一致，进一步强化了SNAP福利不可替代的证据。将家庭食品消费与外出就餐消费同营养数据相关联，我发现SNAP大幅增加了热量购买，但对每卡路里的营养构成影响甚微。一项行为福利校准表明，实物提供的效率成本为每1美元SNAP补助12至14美分；由于这一计算对边际消费倾向高度敏感，因此精确确定该参数在定量上至关重要。
title: Propensity to consume food out of SNAP and its welfare implications
title_zh: SNAP食品消费倾向及其福利影响

abstract: Many regression analyses use observations that are correlated within uncorrelated clusters and/or are correlated in distance or other spatial measure. Such data are often positively correlated. This reduces the information content of an additional observation compared to the default of independent observations. Consequently, failure to adjust standard errors for such correlation leads to confidence intervals that are too narrow, and to hypothesis tests that over reject. In this paper we first provide a general framework. We then focus on inference when observations are correlated within cluster and uncorrelated across clusters. We detail cluster-robust inference methods, particularly methods that provide improved finite-sample performance when there is not a large number of clusters. Such adjustments are often necessary. A companion paper, Cameron and Miller (2026), presents inference when correlation is spatially dampening in the distance between observations. The two papers are intended to provide a guide to empirical researchers.
abstract_zh: 许多回归分析使用的观测值在互不相关的聚类内存在相关性，和/或在距离或其他空间度量上存在相关性。此类数据通常呈正相关。与观测值相互独立的默认情形相比，这会降低额外观测值所包含的信息量。因此，若未能针对这种相关性调整标准误，会导致置信区间过窄，并使假设检验过度拒绝。本文首先提供一个一般性框架。随后，我们聚焦于观测值在聚类内相关、在聚类间不相关时的推断问题。我们详细阐述聚类稳健推断方法，特别是当聚类数量不多时能够提供改进的有限样本表现的方法。此类调整往往是必要的。配套论文Cameron and Miller（2026）提出了当相关性随观测值之间距离而空间衰减时的推断方法。这两篇论文旨在为实证研究者提供指南。
title: Inference for Regression with Clustered or Spatially Correlated Data I: Framework and Clustering
title_zh: 聚类或空间相关数据的回归推断 I：框架与聚类

abstract: This article presents inference for regression with data that are correlated across some measure of distance; most often geographic distance. Failure to appropriately adjust standard errors can lead to confidence intervals that are too narrow, and hypothesis tests that over-reject. If spatial correlation exists within region but not across regions then one can use cluster-robust inference methods presented in the companion paper, Cameron and Miller (2026). In this paper we focus on methods when spatial correlation is dampening in distance. Then the standard inference method is the spatial HAC of Conley (1999). This method does not work well when spatial persistence is high, and alternative inference methods are needed. Additionally it is important that regression models control for any spatial trends to avoid finding spurious correlation.
abstract_zh: 本文提出针对数据在某种距离度量（最常见的是地理距离）上存在相关性的回归推断方法。若未能适当调整标准误，可能导致置信区间过窄，以及假设检验过度拒绝。如果空间相关性存在于区域内而非跨区域，则可以使用配套论文Cameron和Miller（2026）中提出的聚类稳健推断方法。在本文中，我们关注空间相关性随距离衰减的情形。此时标准的推断方法是Conley（1999）的空间HAC方法。当空间持续性较高时，该方法表现不佳，需要替代性的推断方法。此外，回归模型控制任何空间趋势以避免发现伪相关也很重要。
title: Inference for Regression with Clustered or Spatially Correlated Data II: Spatial Correlation
title_zh: 聚类或空间相关数据的回归推断 II：空间相关性

abstract: I estimate a model of health investment, health, and sample participation, and I find substantially wider gaps in cognitive health by education relative to reduced-form estimators, even after accounting for the endogeneity of education. Selective exits (mortality or attrition) among less-educated respondents generate cross-sectional comparisons between highly educated individuals and the subset of healthier, less-educated individuals who survive. Furthermore, I find that education gaps widen at relatively early stages of cognitive decline—contrary to a large literature arguing that education affects levels but not slopes. Finally, I show that differential rates of cigarette smoking by education do not explain these gaps in cognitive health.
abstract_zh: 我估计了一个关于健康投资、健康状况和样本参与的模型，发现相对于简约式估计量，认知健康按教育程度划分的差距要大得多，即使在考虑了教育的内生性之后也是如此。受教育程度较低的受访者中选择性退出（死亡或样本流失）导致横截面比较发生在高受教育程度个体与存活下来的更健康的低受教育程度个体子集之间。此外，我发现教育差距在认知衰退的相对早期阶段就已扩大——这与大量文献认为教育影响水平但不影响斜率的观点相反。最后，我表明，按教育程度划分的吸烟率差异并不能解释这些认知健康差距。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Cognitive decline, education, and dynamic selection
title_zh: 认知衰退、教育与动态选择

abstract: What are the consequences of restoring state authority in territories governed by criminal organizations? Combining household surveys and administrative records with detailed maps of former gang-controlled areas, we study how El Salvador’s 2022 State of Exception, which ended two decades of gang territorial control, reshaped Salvadoran society. We find that the removal of gang control integrated previously segmented labor markets, improving mobility, employment outcomes, household income, and financial inclusion. Areas with greater pre-2022 gang exposure also experienced larger increases in business formation and property investment. However, the legacy of criminal governance persists through residence-based discrimination: employers remain less willing to hire otherwise identical applicants from former gang-controlled neighborhoods. Finally, although overall support for the crackdowns remains high, individuals who witnessed police abuse report substantially greater distrust of the police and the national government, suggesting that abuses of state authority may undermine the political sustainability of tough-on-crime policies.
abstract_zh: 在犯罪组织控制的领土上恢复国家权力的后果是什么？我们结合家庭调查、行政记录与前帮派控制地区的详细地图，研究萨尔瓦多2022年的例外状态——终结了长达二十年的帮派领土控制——如何重塑了萨尔瓦多社会。我们发现，帮派控制的消除整合了此前被分割的劳动力市场，改善了流动性、就业结果、家庭收入和金融普惠。2022年前帮派暴露程度更高的地区，其企业创办和房地产投资增幅也更大。然而，犯罪治理的遗产通过基于居住地的歧视持续存在：雇主仍然不太愿意雇用来自前帮派控制社区但其他方面完全相同的求职者。最后，尽管对打击行动的整体支持率仍然很高，但目睹过警察滥权的个人报告称，他们对警察和中央政府的信任度显著更低，这表明国家权力的滥用可能削弱强硬打击犯罪政策的政治可持续性。
title: Gang Crackdowns
title_zh: 帮派打击行动

abstract: Short-term return reversal is one of the most robust asset-pricing anomalies, and is commonly linked to liquidity provision. We decompose individual firm stock returns into two distinct components: SYS, the component of returns that can be linked to systematic risk and public information releases; and an orthogonal residual RES. The RES component reverses, while the SYS component exhibits continuation. Moreover, the residual reversals are highly asymmetric: positive residual shocks reverse much more slowly than negative shocks. A return factor based on asymmetric idiosyncratic reversal subsumes the idiosyncratic volatility factor and a broad set of other short-horizon anomalies. Our findings suggest that asymmetric idiosyncratic reversal (AIR) is the primary driver of short-term return predictability.
abstract_zh: 短期收益反转是最稳健的资产定价异象之一，通常与流动性提供相关联。我们将个股收益分解为两个不同组成部分：SYS，即收益中可与系统性风险和公开信息发布相关联的部分；以及正交残差RES。RES部分发生反转，而SYS部分则表现出持续性。此外，残差反转具有高度不对称性：正向残差冲击的反转速度远慢于负向冲击。基于不对称特质反转构建的收益因子，能够涵盖特质波动率因子以及一系列其他短期限异象。我们的发现表明，不对称特质反转（AIR）是短期收益可预测性的主要驱动因素。
title: Asymmetric Reversals
title_zh: 非对称逆转

abstract: We analyze the academic affiliations of nearly 6,000 award-winning researchers in 18 major fields in the natural sciences, engineering, and social sciences from the 1820s to the 2020s, focusing on the 1960s onward. The analysis reveals a trend of declining concentration in the institutional affiliations of award-winning researchers, shifting from a few science-strong universities in high-income countries to a more diverse set of institutions across the world. The decline in concentration is observed in all fields except one: economics. The institutional affiliations of prizewinning economists have become more concentrated over time, making economics the most concentrated field. We associate the higher concentration of prizewinning work in economics with the field’s stronger sorting by institutional prestige, its lower reliance on specialized equipment and instruments, and its assessment of findings based on a synthesis of evidence rather than on decisive experiments or proofs. We discuss the benefits and costs of this high and rising institutional concentration of prizewinning economists.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了1820年代至2020年代、重点关注1960年代以后，自然科学、工程学和社会科学18个主要领域中近6000名获奖研究者的学术机构隶属关系。分析揭示出，获奖研究者的机构隶属关系呈现集中度下降的趋势，从高收入国家少数科学实力雄厚的大学转向全球范围内更加多样化的机构。除一个领域外，所有领域的集中度均有所下降：经济学。获奖经济学家的机构隶属关系随时间变得更加集中，使经济学成为集中度最高的领域。我们将经济学获奖研究更高的集中度与该领域更强烈的机构声望排序、对专用设备和仪器的较低依赖，以及基于证据综合而非决定性实验或证明来评估研究结果联系起来。我们讨论了获奖经济学家这种高且不断上升的机构集中所带来的收益与成本。
title: High and Rising Institutional Concentration of Award-Winning Economists
title_zh: 获奖经济学家的机构集中度居高不下且持续上升

abstract: We use newly linked IRS data to study how US multinationals use tax-planning structures that exploit mismatches between US and foreign tax laws. In 2016, these structures accounted for 36% of foreign profits despite being adopted by only 18% of firms. We develop and estimate a structural model using adoption patterns and changes in foreign effective tax rates, domestic and foreign investment, and global R&D following adoption. The model implies substantial heterogeneity in adoption costs and benefits and shows that restricting tax planning creates tradeoffs between tax revenue and economic activity that are amplified by global R&D linkages.
abstract_zh: 我们利用新关联的美国国税局数据，研究美国跨国公司如何运用利用美国与外国税法错配的税务筹划结构。2016年，这些结构占外国利润的36%，尽管仅被18%的企业采用。我们构建并估计了一个结构模型，使用采用模式以及采用后外国有效税率、国内外投资和全球研发的变化。模型表明，采用成本与收益存在显著异质性，并显示限制税务筹划会在税收收入与经济活动之间产生权衡，而全球研发联系会放大这种权衡。
title: Tax Planning and Multinational Behavior
title_zh: 税收筹划与跨国公司行为

abstract: Observational research into the relationship between maternal acetaminophen use during pregnancy and a child’s subsequent risk of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) or autism has been limited by confounding factors. Using two large national U.S. insurance claims databases and a novel natural experiment, we assessed differences in prevalence of ADHD and autism among children whose gestational periods were impacted by a nationwide Tylenol recall issued in 1982, following deaths from Tylenol capsules containing potassium cyanide. Prevalence of ADHD and autism was not significantly different in birth cohorts exposed to the recall during gestation, when maternal acetaminophen use would have been reduced; interrupted time series models showed no significant differences compared to underlying temporal diagnostic trends. These findings are inconsistent with a clinically meaningful effect of maternal acetaminophen use on subsequent development of neurodevelopmental disorders.
abstract_zh: 关于孕期母亲使用对乙酰氨基酚与子女随后发生注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）或自闭症风险之间关系的观察性研究，一直受到混杂因素的限制。我们利用两个大型美国全国性保险索赔数据库和一项新的自然实验，评估了1982年全国范围内泰诺召回事件影响其妊娠期的儿童中ADHD和自闭症的患病率差异。该召回事件发生在含氰化钾的泰诺胶囊导致死亡之后。在妊娠期暴露于该召回事件的出生队列中，母亲对乙酰氨基酚使用本应减少，但ADHD和自闭症的患病率并无显著差异；中断时间序列模型显示，与潜在的时间诊断趋势相比，亦无显著差异。这些发现与母亲使用对乙酰氨基酚对随后神经发育障碍的发生具有临床意义的影响这一观点不一致。
title: In Utero Exposure to the 1982 Tylenol Recall and Neurodevelopmental Outcomes
title_zh: 1982年泰诺召回事件的子宫内暴露与神经发育结局

abstract: This paper considers the estimation of heterogeneous impacts within a Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) in a situation where heterogeneous status is endogenous and is not fully observed in the control sample. We show how to use information in the treatment sample and a noisy signal on the heterogeneous status to estimate meaningful impacts under a minimal set of assumptions. We provide an application of this approach to a data set from Ghana, collected around a clustered RCT to evaluate the impacts of an early-years intervention, differentiating the impact between households that participate actively in the program from those who participate only passively, as recipients. We show that, for some outcomes, the properly estimated heterogeneous impacts differ substantially from those computed with a naive estimator.
abstract_zh: 本文考虑在随机对照试验（RCT）中估计异质性影响的问题，其中异质性状态是内生的，并且在控制样本中无法被完全观测到。我们展示了如何在最小假设集下，利用处理样本中的信息以及关于异质性状态的噪声信号来估计有意义的影响。我们将这一方法应用于一组来自加纳的数据，该数据围绕一项整群随机对照试验收集，用于评估一项早期儿童干预的影响，并区分积极参与项目的家庭与仅作为接受者被动参与的家庭之间的影响差异。我们表明，对于某些结果而言，经过恰当估计的异质性影响与使用朴素估计量计算得到的结果存在显著差异。
title: Estimating Heterogeneous Impacts with Endogenous Participation and Non-Compliance
title_zh: 估计具有内生参与和不依从的异质性影响

abstract: We provide the first causal evidence on how long-term exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) at contemporary ambient levels contributes to the development of chronic disease in a young, initially healthy population. Our analysis links detailed personnel records for roughly 150,000 U.S. Army soldiers to high-resolution annual measures of PM2.5. Because soldiers enter service exceptionally healthy and receive uniform access to care, new diagnoses reflect pollution’s physiological impact rather than preexisting conditions or differential health care access. They are also required to relocate based on the needs of the Army, which provides us with quasi-random variation in initial duty-station assignments that we use as an instrument for average annual pollution exposure over a soldier’s career. We find that sustained PM2.5 exposure substantially increases circulatory disease, particularly hypertension, with mixed evidence on respiratory conditions that are sensitive to specification. Exposure over shorter durations, by contrast, has little detectable effect, a pattern consistent with the cumulative nature of pollution’s health burden. These findings demonstrate that even moderate long-term exposure to air pollution can erode health capital in ways that are invisible to studies focused on short-run variations or mortality alone, and they highlight the importance of regulatory standards that account for chronic exposure risks.
abstract_zh: 我们首次提供了因果证据，说明在当代环境水平下长期暴露于细颗粒物（PM2.5）如何促使一个年轻且初始健康的人群罹患慢性病。我们的分析将约15万名美国陆军士兵的详细人事记录与高分辨率年度PM2.5测量数据相链接。由于士兵入伍时极为健康，并享有统一的医疗服务，新诊断反映的是污染的生理影响，而非既存疾病或医疗服务获取差异。他们还须根据陆军需要调动，这为我们提供了初始驻地分配的准随机变异，我们将其作为士兵职业生涯中年均污染暴露的工具变量。我们发现，持续暴露于PM2.5会显著增加循环系统疾病，尤其是高血压，而对呼吸系统状况的证据则因设定不同而混杂。相比之下，较短时间的暴露几乎没有可检测到的影响，这一模式与污染健康负担的累积性质相一致。这些发现表明，即使是对空气污染的适度长期暴露，也会以仅关注短期变化或死亡率的研究所无法察觉的方式侵蚀健康资本，并凸显了将慢性暴露风险纳入考量的监管标准的重要性。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国陆军士兵及美国PM2.5暴露，数据与制度背景均为美国，不涉及中国。
title: The Effects of Long-Term Exposure to Pollution on Health
title_zh: 长期暴露于污染对健康的影响

abstract: Several countries are adopting social media bans for teenagers, yet early evidence suggests limited adherence to the age-based restrictions. Such bans ask platforms to remove profitable customers and teens to give up access to their online social networks. We study an alternative regulatory regime in which platforms remain liable for teens on the adult tier but may offer a safe tier that removes restricted features, such as algorithmic feeds, while preserving interactions with their relevant network. Provision of the safe tier and enforcement are complementary: teens can adhere without giving up access to their network, and platforms can retain displaced adult-tier users as lower-margin customers. This policy design makes the teen decision to avoid the adult tier less dependent on peer dynamics and increases teen welfare for a relevant range of regulatory penalties.
abstract_zh: 若干国家正对青少年实施社交媒体禁令，但早期证据表明，基于年龄的限制措施执行依从性有限。此类禁令要求平台移除可带来利润的用户，并要求青少年放弃访问其在线社交网络。我们研究了一种替代性监管制度：在该制度下，平台仍对处于成人层级的青少年承担责任，但可提供一个安全层级，该层级移除受限功能（如算法信息流），同时保留青少年与其相关网络的互动。安全层级的提供与执法具有互补性：青少年无需放弃对其网络的访问即可遵守规定，平台也可将转移出的成人层级用户保留为较低利润率的客户。在相关监管处罚范围内，这一政策设计使青少年避免进入成人层级的决定较少依赖同伴动态，并提高了青少年福利。
title: Aligning Platform and User Incentives in Social Media Age Restrictions
title_zh: 协调社交媒体年龄限制中的平台与用户激励

abstract: Many large, publicly-traded companies adopt voluntary greenhouse gas emission reduction commitments in the presence of a fragmented public policy landscape. To explore the potential emission implications of such commitments, we develop a framework for understanding how firms’ voluntary emission targets interact with carbon pricing, regulatory mandates, subsidies, and heterogeneous policies across political jurisdictions. This analysis highlights the difficulty of distinguishing incremental voluntary emission abatement from policy-induced emission reductions. We introduce the Salata Institute Corporate Climate Targets Database, which we produced from public domain reports published by Russell 3000 firms over 2000-2024. The database documents the growth, form, scope, and sectoral distribution of voluntary greenhouse gas emission targets, including net-zero, carbon-neutral, carbon-reduction, energy-related, and qualitative commitments. Comparing this database with CDP, a non-profit organization formerly known as the Carbon Disclosure Project and the most common source of corporate emission targets used in the research literature, reveals substantial omissions in their survey-based data, especially in recent years. We show that voluntary corporate targets often mirror government-established goals and public policies, and some firms benchmark their internal carbon prices to existing carbon taxes and emission trading systems. The paper concludes by outlining empirical challenges and future research needs for evaluating the emission impacts of voluntary commitments.
abstract_zh: 许多大型上市公司在公共政策格局碎片化的背景下，自愿采取温室气体减排承诺。为探讨此类承诺可能带来的排放影响，我们构建了一个分析框架，用以理解企业自愿减排目标如何与碳定价、监管指令、补贴以及不同政治辖区间的异质性政策相互作用。该分析凸显了区分增量性自愿减排与政策引致的减排所面临的困难。我们推出了萨拉塔研究所企业气候目标数据库（Salata Institute Corporate Climate Targets Database），该数据库基于罗素3000指数企业在2000—2024年间发布的公开领域报告编制而成。该数据库记录了自愿温室气体排放目标的增长、形式、范围及部门分布，包括净零、碳中和、碳减排、能源相关及定性承诺。将该数据库与CDP（一家非营利组织，前身为碳披露项目，是研究文献中最常用的企业排放目标来源）进行比较，发现其基于调查的数据存在大量遗漏，尤其是在近年来。我们表明，企业自愿目标往往与政府设定的目标和公共政策相呼应，一些企业将其内部碳价格与现有碳税和排放交易体系进行对标。本文最后概述了评估自愿承诺排放影响的实证挑战与未来研究需求。
title: Voluntary Corporate Climate Targets in a Patchwork Policy Landscape
title_zh: 拼凑政策格局下的企业自愿气候目标

abstract: Line drawing is a pervasive feature of legal systems. Across many domains, the applicable legal treatment turns on whether an activity falls above or below some threshold. We characterize the economic forces that determine the optimal placement of such thresholds, both generally and in specific legal settings involving monetary and non-monetary sanctions, prohibitions, and mandates. We apply our results to two important line-drawing questions in private law: the optimal due-care threshold for negligence liability and the optimal threshold for whether a shortfall in contract performance constitutes breach. In both applications, the optimal line takes the form of a population-level marginal cost-benefit rule, with the relevant costs and benefits weighted over the actors whose behavior the line induces to change.
abstract_zh: 划线是法律体系中一个普遍存在的特征。在许多领域，适用的法律处理取决于某项活动是高于还是低于某一阈值。我们刻画了决定此类阈值最优设定的经济力量，既包括一般情形，也包括涉及金钱与非金钱制裁、禁止与命令的具体法律情境。我们将研究结果应用于私法中两个重要的划线问题：过失责任的最优注意义务阈值，以及合同履行中的瑕疵是否构成违约的最优阈值。在这两项应用中，最优界线均采取总体层面的边际成本收益规则形式，其中相关成本与收益根据该界线所诱使行为发生改变的行动者进行加权。
title: Optimal Line-Drawing for Legal Rules
title_zh: 法律规则的最优界线划定

abstract: To study monetary policy transmission at the firm level, researchers typically consider heterogeneity along a small number of firm characteristics, such as size or leverage. We instead estimate the full distribution of firms’ investment responses to monetary policy, using a clustering regression framework. Our novel approach captures multidimensional and unobservable heterogeneity across firms and time. We find that investment by most firms in most time periods responds little to monetary policy. Only about 5% of firm-time observations are associated with a strong response. We then investigate the sources of heterogeneity ex post. We find that most of the variation in investment sensitivity arises within firms over time. Although several firm characteristics predict responsiveness to monetary policy, the majority of heterogeneity remains unexplained by firm observables. We demonstrate that our empirical estimates provide new targets for disciplining structural models of firm heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 为研究企业层面的货币政策传导，研究者通常考察少数企业特征（如规模或杠杆率）上的异质性。我们则采用聚类回归框架，估计企业投资对货币政策响应的完整分布。我们的新方法捕捉了企业间和企业内跨时间的多维且不可观测的异质性。我们发现，在大多数时间段内，大多数企业的投资对货币政策响应甚微。仅有约5%的企业-时间观测值与强响应相关。随后，我们事后探究异质性的来源。我们发现，投资敏感性的大部分变异源自企业自身随时间的变化。尽管若干企业特征能够预测对货币政策的响应程度，但大部分异质性仍无法由企业可观测变量解释。我们证明，我们的实证估计为约束企业异质性结构模型提供了新的目标。
title: The Investment Channel of Monetary Policy: Disentangling Firm Heterogeneity
title_zh: 货币政策的投资渠道：解析企业异质性

abstract: Artificial intelligence is driving a large expansion in data center capacity, power infrastructure, and specialized computing equipment. We estimate that a 1 GW AI campus costs about $41 billion. A 188 GW U.S. buildout completed by 2032 would require total investment of nearly$9 trillion and amount to annual investment of 3.2 percent of GDP over 2025–2032. As hyperscaler capital expenditures outgrow internal cash flow, financing is shifting toward leases, joint ventures, project debt, private credit, securitization, and special-purpose vehicles. These structures expand funding capacity but also raise asset-level leverage, obscure contingent obligations, and expose investors to tenant concentration, technological obsolescence, execution delays, and uncertain residual values.
abstract_zh: 人工智能正在推动数据中心容量、电力基础设施和专用计算设备的大规模扩张。我们估计，一个1 GW的AI园区成本约为410亿美元。若到2032年完成188 GW的美国建设规模，所需总投资将接近9万亿美元，相当于2025—2032年间每年投资占GDP的3.2%。随着超大规模企业的资本支出增长超过其内部现金流，融资方式正转向租赁、合资企业、项目债务、私人信贷、证券化和特殊目的载体。这些结构扩大了融资能力，但也提高了资产层面的杠杆，模糊了或有义务，并使投资者面临租户集中度、技术过时、执行延迟以及剩余价值不确定等风险。
title: Financing the AI Buildout
title_zh: 为人工智能建设融资

abstract: We study how the shale revolution and the U.S. transition from petroleum importer to net exporter have changed the macroeconomic effects of oil shocks. Using oil supply news shocks identified from OPEC announcements, a time-varying model of the U.S. macroeconomy shows that the contractionary effects weakened over time and eventually became expansionary. State-dependent local projections link this change to the U.S. petroleum trade balance. The improvement goes beyond mechanical net export effects: as the terms-of-trade response turns more favorable, consumption, equity valuations, and activity strengthen broadly across sectors and regions, pointing to general-equilibrium income and wealth effects. A counterfactual analysis of the 2022 oil price surge implies sharply different paths for U.S. activity, prices, and monetary policy under the propagation mechanisms prevailing before the shale boom vs. the early 2020s.
abstract_zh: 我们研究页岩革命以及美国从石油进口国转变为净出口国如何改变了石油冲击的宏观经济效应。利用从OPEC公告中识别的石油供给新闻冲击，一个美国宏观经济的时变模型显示，其紧缩效应随时间推移而减弱，并最终转为扩张性。状态依赖局部投影将这一变化与美国石油贸易差额联系起来。这一改善超出了机械性的净出口效应：随着贸易条件反应变得更加有利，消费、股票估值和活动在各行业和地区普遍走强，指向一般均衡的收入和财富效应。对2022年油价飙升的反事实分析表明，在页岩繁荣之前与21世纪20年代初盛行的传导机制下，美国活动、价格和货币政策的路径存在显著差异。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国经济、页岩革命与石油冲击，数据与制度背景均为美国，不涉及中国。
title: From Importer to Exporter: Oil Shocks and the U.S. Economy
title_zh: 从进口国到出口国：石油冲击与美国经济

abstract: What caused the 2000s housing cycle? This article synthesizes two decades of research, including reduced-form empirics and structural models. Although often contentious, the literature coheres once one accounts for each study’s timing, place, methodology, and measurement. The cycle was a perfect storm that occurred in distinct stages. Starting in the late 1990s, fundamentals improved, and credit supply increased across the income distribution due to automated underwriting and financial deregulation. In the early 2000s, a decline in interest rates was followed by a further expansion in securitized and subprime credit, the origin of which remains controversial. This sequence of shocks produced a persistent boom that triggered two shifts in beliefs: average expectations became overly optimistic, pushing prices higher, and expectations diverged, fueling speculation. In the bust, prices overshot primarily due to mortgage defaults, which removed buyers and contracted credit supply. How these forces interact and how expectations form require further research.
abstract_zh: 是什么导致了2000年代的住房周期？本文综合了二十年来的研究，包括简约式实证与结构模型。尽管常存争议，但一旦考虑每项研究的时间、地点、方法论和测量方式，文献便呈现出内在一致性。这一周期是一场完美风暴，分阶段发生。自1990年代末开始，基本面改善，且由于自动核保和金融去监管，信贷供给在收入分布各层次上增加。2000年代初，利率下降之后，证券化和次级信贷进一步扩张，其起源仍存争议。这一系列冲击产生了持续繁荣，并引发了两类信念转变：平均预期变得过度乐观，推高价格；预期出现分化，助长投机。在萧条阶段，价格过度下跌主要源于抵押贷款违约，这减少了买方并收缩了信贷供给。这些力量如何相互作用以及预期如何形成，仍需进一步研究。
title: Reassessing the 2000s Housing Cycle After Two Decades of Research
title_zh: 重新评估历经二十年研究后的2000年代住房周期

abstract: Why do rising powers survive periods in which established states can still suppress them? Existing theories of preventive war emphasize commitment problems between declining and rising states, which can make adverse power shifts especially dangerous. We show that commitment problems among established rivals can have the opposite effect. Preventive action against a rising power can alter the incumbent’s relationship with another state. Under opportunistic rivalry, prevention temporarily exposes the incumbent to exploitation by an existing rival. Under defensive rivalry, successful prevention strengthens the incumbent by eliminating a potential counterweight, giving its rival an incentive to protect the rising state. In both cases, third-party responses can deter preventive action that would occur in an otherwise identical dyadic setting. Cooperation among established powers can reverse this result when credible arrangements allow them to manage the strategic consequences of suppression. Historical evidence from the American Revolution, China’s nuclear emergence, and U.S.–Soviet bargaining over West German nuclear capabilities illustrates the mechanisms and their limits. The analysis shows how rivalry among established powers can protect vulnerable rising states and thereby facilitate changes in the international distribution of power.
abstract_zh: 为什么崛起大国能够在既有大国仍能压制它们的时期生存下来？既有预防性战争理论强调衰落大国与崛起大国之间的承诺问题，这会使不利的权力转移尤为危险。我们表明，既有对手之间的承诺问题可能产生相反的效果。针对崛起大国的预防性行动可能改变 incumbent 与另一国家的关系。在机会主义竞争下，预防行动会暂时使 incumbent 暴露于既有对手的利用之下。在防御性竞争下，成功的预防行动会通过消除潜在制衡者而增强 incumbent，从而使其对手有动机保护崛起国家。在这两种情况下，第三方反应都可能威慑原本会在其他方面相同的二元情境中发生的预防性行动。当可信安排使既有大国能够管理压制的战略后果时，既有大国之间的合作可以逆转这一结果。来自美国独立战争、中国核崛起以及美苏围绕西德核能力讨价还价的历史证据说明了这些机制及其局限。该分析表明，既有大国之间的竞争如何能够保护脆弱的崛起国家，从而促进国际权力分配的变化。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅将中国核崛起作为历史案例之一，核心研究对象是大国竞争与预防性战争的一般理论，中国并非主要研究对象或数据背景。
title: The Geopolitical Trap: How Great Power Rivalry Protects Rising Powers
title_zh: 地缘政治陷阱：大国竞争如何保护崛起中的大国

abstract: Work experience has been found to be a key determinant of work and wages for educated women, but it seems to play a smaller role for the less educated. For them, welfare, tax credits and family composition matter more, and increasingly so does participation in disability programmes. Here we document how labor supply, wages, health, and disability claims have evolved in the UK over the last three decades, and examine how reforms to tax credits, disability benefits and other welfare programs have changed work incentives over this period. We then introduce these features into an empirical dynamic structural model of life-cycle labor supply, human capital and disability benefit application, in which human capital combines health capital, experience accumulated in work, and education. Estimating the model on a panel of working-age women in the UK, we examine the interactions between experience capital and health capital in driving life-cycle earnings across different education groups. Our results highlight the importance of interactions in the disability benefit, welfare and tax-credit systems for understanding the life cycle pattern of hours, employment, earnings, and disability claims, and for evaluating policy counterfactuals.
title: Labor Supply and Wages over the Life Cycle: Human Capital and Disability Benefits
title_zh: 生命周期中的劳动供给与工资：人力资本与残疾福利

abstract: Private capital fund managers appear to possess significant information about the relative quality of their portfolio firms even within the first three years after the investment. But the way this information is disclosed to investors changes dynamically: Textual discussions of portfolio companies have substantial information about the firms’ ultimate performance in the early stages of investment, while interim valuations are less important. Over time, this pattern reverses, with interim valuations becoming more important in explaining future returns, especially after portfolio companies have a financing event. The results vary not only with the tone but also with the content of fund manager disclosures. In an opaque market with substantial information asymmetries, textual discussions seem to serve as a signal about general partner quality.
title: Communicating Performance: Textual and Financial Disclosures in Private Equity
title_zh: 沟通绩效：私募股权中的文本与财务披露

abstract: Large language models are diffusing rapidly into science, raising concerns that delegating research writing to AI may undermine the development of expertise that scientific training is supposed to build. We measure AI-generated writing in the dissertations of a near-census of US STEM PhD graduates from 2019 to 2026 and link graduates to their subsequent employment. AI writing is absent before 2023, present in 29% of dissertations filed in 2026, and rapidly growing. Use is more common among students from non-English-speaking countries and at lower-ranked programs. Among graduates in the same program and cohort, those whose dissertations contain AI writing are less likely to enter academic research careers and more likely to enter non-tenure-track roles or industry, with this pattern strongest among US-origin students. At the same time as AI may increase research productivity, it thus appears to also be displacing a potentially important portion of the work through which scientific expertise is developed.
title: How Heavily Are PhD Students Offloading Their Scientific Writing to AI? Evidence from US STEM PhD Dissertations
title_zh: 博士生将科学写作外包给人工智能的程度有多高？来自美国STEM博士论文的证据

abstract: Stressful events are associated with long-term adverse health impacts, but the causal mechanisms linking exposures to disease remain poorly understood. One mechanism is persistent changes to hormonal signaling that regulate metabolic homeostasis. We examine the long-term impacts of stress associated with exposure to the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami on levels of free triiodothyronine (FT3), a circulating measure of biologically active thyroid hormone, using data from the Study of Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. Biomarkers are measured 20 years post-tsunami in a population-representative sample age 35y+ in 2024 who, at the time of the tsunami, were living along the coast of Aceh, Indonesia, the area hardest-hit by the tsunami. Because respondents were first interviewed before the tsunami and subsequently tracked regardless of migration, the sample avoids selection bias common in long-term disaster studies. We identify the causal effect of tsunami exposure using variation in community-level tsunami mortality, comparing communities within the same sub-district. We find that greater tsunami exposure reduced levels of FT3 20 years later. Exposure also altered relationships between FT3, body composition, and cortisol and increased cardiometabolic risk. These findings identify persistent alteration of thyroid hormone physiology as a potential pathway linking severe stressful exposures to long-term cardiometabolic disease risk.
title: Stressful Exposure from the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami Drives Long-term Changes in Thyroid Hormone Physiology
title_zh: 2004年印度洋海啸的压力暴露驱动甲状腺激素生理的长期变化

abstract: New machinery has long been argued to raise the relative demand for skilled labor, yet firm-level evidence finds no such shift at investing firms. We resolve this puzzle by looking beyond firm boundaries. Linking Belgian data on capital investments, buyer–supplier transactions, and worker skills, we show that the skill bias of new machinery arises entirely at external suppliers. Following machinery investment spikes, purchases from suppliers raise firms’ total demand for high-STEM workers by 45%, three times the rise for other skill groups, while in-house hiring raises it by less than 5%, evenly across skill groups. This external demand comes first from machine integrators and later from complementary services such as software, and is stronger for smaller firms, lumpier investments, and rapidly advancing capital, consistent with fixed and adjustment costs of hiring high-STEM workers in-house. In a general-equilibrium model estimated on our event studies, the rise in machinery per worker from 2003 to 2021 raises relative demand for high-STEM workers by 8.8 log points and their wage premium by 3.1. Measured on payrolls alone, both would fall.
title: Capital-Skill Complementarity Beyond Firm Boundaries
title_zh: 资本与技能互补性超越企业边界

abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic caused a sharp initial rise in unemployment, followed by an unexpectedly tight labor market. Using a panel of tax data containing newly assembled information on worker occupation, we document persistent labor force exit, especially among low-income and low-skill workers. Low-skilled unmarried men are by far the most likely to exit, reinforcing recent concerns regarding the economic and social engagement of this group. Contrary to prevailing theories, we find little evidence that school closures, virus exposure, stimulus payments, or unemployment benefits explain these exits. Nor is the exit explained by additional upgrading of occupations or firm quality. Individuals who leave the labor force do not (on average) make up the missing income; however, self-employment income replaces roughly a quarter of the lost W-2 income. The facts suggest that the willingness to work for low pay decreased and preferences for leisure and job flexibility increased among a large set of workers who have found ways to get by with less income. These results have implications for tax policy, fiscal projections, and labor market dynamics in the post-pandemic economy.
title: Which Workers Left the Labor Force Post-COVID Recession and Why?: Filing, Tax Credit Take-Up, and Labor Force Engagement by Occupation
title_zh: 新冠疫情衰退后哪些工人退出了劳动力市场及其原因？：按职业划分的申请、税收抵免利用与劳动力市场参与

abstract: Occupational licensing is a widespread quality regulation that potentially increases the quality of labor but reduces its quantity. We provide a theoretical framework to empirically quantify this trade-off in public hospitals, where both clinical quality and physician shortages are critical concerns. Using quasi-exogenous variation driven by a recent and unprecedented migration of physicians to Chile, together with growth in domestic medical schools, we show that more physicians improve patient outcomes, while lower-quality physicians—as measured by licensing exam performance—worsen them. Incorporating these findings into our theoretical framework, we evaluate the implications of locally changing the stringency of the licensing policy.
title: Physicians' Occupational Licensing and the Quantity-Quality Trade-off
title_zh: 医生的职业许可与数量-质量权衡

abstract: Whether imposing higher taxes on business owners adversely affects business activity by constraining investment and inducing capitalist flight is a central question in the ongoing debate on how to tax the ultra wealthy. To shed new light, I exploit a series of related Norwegian reforms during 2021–2024 that increased dividend tax rates, removed migration-related capital gains tax loopholes, and nearly doubled the effective marginal tax rate on business wealth. These reforms spurred international debate and, allegedly, an “exodus” of Norwegian billionaires (Financial Times, 2023). While I document clear effects on migration, these responses are concentrated among the top 0.1% of the wealth distribution and mostly confined to 2022 and 2023. My results indicate that at most 100 individuals left due to the reforms. I find no evidence of significant outmigration or reduced inflows of startup founders or inventors. I estimate that absent any outmigration, wealth tax revenues would have increased by 75% from 2021 to 2024. Reform-driven outmigration lowers the revenue gain to 71.5%. My findings further show that outmigrating owners’ firms remain economically active and do not reduce investment. In a broader set of analyses, I examine whether business outcomes are affected, regardless of whether owners outmigrate, since firms may reduce investment both due to liquidity constraints or distortions to owners’ savings decisions. I compare firms owned by Norwegian individuals subject to the wealth tax with firms owned by foreigners and other tax-exempt entities. By merging historical ownership data from Orbis with the Norwegian shareholder register, I perform these analyses on both Norwegian and foreign-domiciled firms. Across settings, I find no evidence that Norwegian-owned firms pay out more dividends or invest less after the reforms, nor is there any evidence that the reform induced more bankruptcies. These findings indicate that the short-run economic costs of wealth taxation, in terms of migration and firm investment, are more limited than the public debate implies.
title: Taxing Entrepreneurial Wealth: Evidence from Norway, 2021–2025
title_zh: 对创业财富征税：来自挪威2021–2025年的证据

abstract: Area-level measures of economic opportunity are increasingly used to guide place-based policies. We study whether these measures predict long-run outcomes for a vulnerable population: over 12,000 refugee children quasi-randomly assigned to municipalities under Denmark's 1986–1998 dispersal policy. We focus on predetermined measures of opportunity available when children arrive and validate them using a mover-exposure design among permanent residents. Moving from a low- to a high-opportunity area (a two-standard-deviation increase) raises adult income rank by 3 percentile points (7.5 percent) and employment by 4 percentage points. It also reduces criminal convictions by 14 percent and teen parenthood by 19 percent, with more modest effects on educational attainment. Economic opportunity predicts crime and teen parenthood more strongly than other area characteristics, including local crime rates. For adult income, area-level inequality is a particularly strong predictor. These findings suggest that social mobility in the areas where refugee children grow up meaningfully shapes their long-term wellbeing.
title: Randomized to Opportunity: Measuring Place Effects for Refugee Children
title_zh: 随机分配至机会：衡量难民儿童的社区效应

abstract: How do depopulation and population aging evolve differently across regions within a country, and what are their implications for aggregate economic activity and regional inequality? Using spatially disaggregated data from Japan over the past several decades, we show that rural areas have experienced significantly faster depopulation and aging than urban areas, driven by low fertility and sustained out-migration of young cohorts. Regions undergoing these trends face declining local amenities and rising per-capita public service costs. To study the future evolution and economic consequences of these dynamics, we develop and calibrate a dynamic life-cycle spatial general equilibrium model. The model predicts widening geographic disparities in depopulation, aging, and economic activity in the coming centuries. While subsidies to declining regions can lower regional inequality, they come at the cost of lower aggregate efficiency and higher public service expenditures.
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为日本的人口减少与老龄化，使用日本数据，不涉及中国。
title: Living in a Ghost Town: The Geography of Depopulation and Aging
title_zh: 生活在鬼城：人口减少与老龄化的地理分布

abstract: Do early investments in parents pay off even when treatment effects for children appear to fade out quickly? We answer this question by leveraging a field experiment in which households with 3-5 year-old children were randomized into a parenting program, a preschool, or a control group, combined with a natural experiment (Covid-19 school closures) that occurred ten years later. Prior to the closures, treatment effects on academic achievement had faded to zero across all groups. Yet, with Covid-19 school closures, effects of the parenting program re-emerge: test scores in control and preschool groups drop by roughly 0.25-0.30 SD, whereas scores in the parenting group drop by only 0.11 SD (difference: p = 0.01). Our findings suggest that parenting programs can generate latent human capital that only becomes visible when complementary school inputs are removed. This result is consonant with parental and school investments acting as substitutes in skill production. Because this latent parental capacity pays off precisely when school inputs fail, standard measurement tools for early childhood programs can miss crucial state-contingent value.
title: Latent Human Capital: How Early Investments in Parents Buffer Against Future Schooling Shocks
title_zh: 潜在人力资本：父母早期投资如何缓冲未来教育冲击

abstract: We characterize the size of the range of multiple equilibria in sovereign debt markets. We show that the nature of the equilibrium depends crucially on the degree of uncertainty, which we formalize first as uncertainty about primary balances and later as uncertainty about the fiscal feedback rule. For low uncertainty, the range can be large, but it becomes smaller as uncertainty becomes larger. If uncertainty is large enough, the multiplicity disappears: the interest rate is unique and becomes a continuous function of the debt level. The source of these results is that larger uncertainty decreases the effect of the perceived probability of default on the actual probability of default, thus reducing and eventually eliminating the scope for multiplicity. Interpreting the source of an increase in the interest rate in actual situations is difficult, and complicates the use of intervention by central banks.
title: Debt Sustainability and the Range of Multiple Equilibria
title_zh: 债务可持续性与多重均衡的范围

abstract: We study strategic responses by firms to threshold-based regulations. We document extensive bunching in response to additional staffing requirements for California nursing homes with at least 100 beds. To estimate the regulation’s effect on staffing, we develop a novel treatment effects estimator for threshold-based regulations under precise manipulation, by decomposing firms into response types based on counterfactual and realized staffing and size, separating causal effects from selection. We estimate that higher staffing above the threshold is nearly entirely due to selection, with low-staffing facilities manipulating their size to avoid the regulation. These size distortions limit access, particularly for disadvantaged patients.
title: Avoiding Regulation: Evidence from Nursing Homes
title_zh: 规避监管：来自养老院的证据

abstract: Licensure sales requirements are commonly justified as consumer protection regulations intended to improve seller compliance and reduce harm associated with risky products. However, licensure effects may differ across communities with heterogeneous enforcement intensity and seller responses. We study this question in the context of e-cigarette retail licensure laws (ERLLs), a policy intended to regulate access to e-cigarettes among youth. We find that state ERLLs with strong penalties for non-compliance reduce nicotine vaping among Black youths by 2.5-4.0 percentage points but have no effect on White youths. This racially disparate finding is driven by heterogeneous supply-side responses to increased regulatory burden. Vendors in Black neighborhoods are more likely to be targeted for inspections than those in White neighborhoods despite having lower pre-treatment rates of infractions. Moreover, vendors in Black neighborhoods are also less likely to sell e-cigarettes following ERLL adoption, consistent with a racially disparate regulatory burden. Together, our results suggest important distributional consequences of licensure requirements.
title: The Regulatory Burden of Licensure Sales Laws: New Evidence on Race and the U.S. Tobacco Market
title_zh: 执照销售法的监管负担：关于种族与美国烟草市场的新证据

abstract: We study an accelerated 3-year math curriculum offered in the middle schools of a large urban district that enables students to finish Algebra I and Geometry before high school. Entry to the program is based on 5th-grade math test scores, with a cutoff at the 80th percentile. Continuing eligibility requires at least a B grade in the previous year; successful completion of all three years is highly correlated with an index of non-cognitive skills. Following students for 6 years after high school graduation, we find that the impacts of admission vary widely by non-cognitive skill and gender. Marginally eligible boys with high non-cognitive skills have a 33 percentage point (ppt.) increase in the probability of completing calculus by 11th grade and a 12 ppt. increase in the probability of completing a major in STEM or business within 6 years; boys with lower noncognitive skills take more advanced math classes in high school but have no significant effects on their college outcomes. Like their male peers, marginally eligible girls with high non-cognitive skills are more likely to complete calculus by 11th grade (+17 ppt.). Their rate of graduating with a STEM or business major is unaffected, but they switch from social sciences to the core STEM majors (science, engineering and math). Girls in the two lower terciles of non-cognitive skill are also strongly affected by entry to the program, with higher participation in advanced math classes in high school, higher rates of entry to selective 4-year colleges, and higher rates of completing a STEM or business major (+12 ppt).
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象是美国某大型城市学区的初中数学加速课程，数据、制度与政策背景均为美国，未涉及中国、香港或台湾。
title: Targeted Acceleration in Middle School Math: Impacts on College Entry, Degree Completion, and STEM
title_zh: 初中数学定向加速：对大学入学、学位完成及STEM领域的影响

abstract: As prediction markets become more prominent, there are concerns that they will be a conduit for political bias. I analyze prediction markets returns from 1880 to 2025 and find no evidence of an overpricing of either left or right-leaning candidates, across a variety of subsamples. In recent elections, there is also no overpricing of either male or female, white or non-white, or young or old candidates. Most political prediction markets exhibit a favorite-longshot bias, and markets on near-term polling averages exhibit a very small overpricing of left-leaning outcomes (e.g., President Trump’s approval falling), which is detectable only because the sample size is large. For elections, however, despite attracting participants who may not be representative of the voting population, prediction markets yield predictions without systematic bias.
title: Are Prediction Markets Politically Biased?
title_zh: 预测市场存在政治偏见吗？

abstract: PredictIt is a CFTC-regulated US prediction market focused on political outcomes. It was very successful in attracting participants in the 2016-22 period, running liquid markets on topics predecessors had tried unsuccesfully. During this period, investors were limited to $850 positions in each contract, which limited arbitrage trading. PredictIt exhibited much larger pricing biases than previously studied prediction markets. Bid prices often persistently added to more than 110, implying an immediate arbitrage profit even after fees. Prices exhibited an overpricing of longshots that was larger than in other prediction markets. The experience of PredictIt suggests that limiting stakes may undermine the ability of prediction markets to accurately price event probabilities.
title: Limits to Arbitrage and Prediction Market Efficiency: the Case of PredictIt
title_zh: 套利限制与预测市场效率：PredictIt案例

abstract: This paper studies the utilization of dental services during the recent implementation of an adult (age 21 and over) Medicaid dental benefit in West Virginia. We analyze claims data and find: 1) before implementation, quarterly utilization of preventative and restorative services falls from 8% at age 20 to virtually 0% at age 21; 2) post-implementation, utilization falls from 8% at age 20 to 5% at age 21, implying a net increase of 50% of baseline utilization; 3) the net effect of the dental benefit is significantly larger in counties with a larger number of oral health care provider practices. Our results provide evidence that public health insurance expansions are dampened in markets with a limited supply of provider practices.
title: Aging Out of Coverage: Lessons from the West Virginia $1,000 Adult Dental Benefit
title_zh: 超龄脱保：西弗吉尼亚州1，000美元成人牙科福利的教训

abstract: Complementarities can have important welfare consequences, but quantifying these effects would seem to require identifying and valuing the underlying mechanisms separately. This paper shows that this need not be the case. I provide necessary and sufficient conditions under which baseline subsidized activity and the direct and total responses to a subsidy determine aggregate willingness to pay. A sufficient condition for valuing the equilibrium adjustment is that it has the same effect on utility as an additional subsidy common to all agents and relevant actions. The formula is easy to apply to existing estimates and guides the design of new experiments.
title: Welfare Analysis with Complementarities: When Direct and Total Responses Are Sufficient
title_zh: 互补性下的福利分析：当直接反应与总反应充分时

abstract: Does education lead to political activity? We find that a large, early 20th century school construction program, the Rosenwald schools, led to more NAACP branches in the rural South starting in the early 1940s, i.e. prior to the classic U.S. Civil Rights Movement. Branch growth was stronger where Jim Crow occupational segregation prevented Black men from realizing some of the economic gains of their education. Our findings lend support to theories emphasizing that economic context can act as a critical mediator in determining whether human capital causes political engagement.
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为20世纪早期美国南方Rosenwald学校与NAACP分支，属美国民权运动背景，与中国无关。
title: Schooling and Political Activism in the Early Civil Rights Era
title_zh: 早期民权时代的学校教育与政治行动主义

abstract: An advertiser in a second-price auction sees what it paid, not the rival bids that supposedly set the price. Akbarpour and Li (2020) show that an auctioneer can therefore charge a winner up to its bid undetected. The Federal Trade Commission alleges that Amazon’s advertising auctions, described as second-price, used soft reserves that did this. We ask whether repeated bidding exposes such charges and what adjustment does to welfare. If each charge equal to the bid is flagged, the soft reserve is exposed quickly, however much the advertiser trusted the description. If reports show only win rates and expected charges, it is indistinguishable from a second-price auction at any fixed bid: an advertiser that trusts the description and bids its value never learns, and one that doubts it but bids for current profit needs a number of auctions at least inversely proportional to its doubt before it considers a soft reserve more likely than not. The second-price description and aggregate reporting are complements. Among informed, symmetric advertisers, the soft reserve raises no more revenue than a second-price auction, and when only some advertisers adjust, placements are misallocated. Disclosure returns surplus to advertisers; removing the surcharge also restores efficiency.
title: Soft Reserves, Learning and Bid Adjustment in Advertising Auctions
title_zh: 广告拍卖中的软储备、学习与出价调整

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly provide economic and financial advice. We develop a microeconomic framework for understanding this role. We prove that an LLM acts like a voting rule: each input text is an election, possible continuations are candidates, and output probabilities are vote shares derived from the training corpus. Such rules can generate Condorcet cycles, implying intransitive pairwise recommendations and potential money-pump exploitation. Using ChatGPT-4o, we identify millions of cycles in pairwise investment choices among S&P 100 firms. Our theorems establish the voting interpretation on the training data and support its use off-sample. We also show that correcting cycles ex post is generally infeasible. Finally, temperature changes the voting rule: at T = 1, outputs are sampled in proportion to vote shares; lower temperatures favor the plurality winner, whereas higher temperatures flatten probabilities toward uniformity.
title: Large Language Models as Voting Mechanisms
title_zh: 大语言模型作为投票机制

abstract: When does bad news stick? This paper shows that the persistence of media sentiment depends not only on whether news is good or bad, but also on what the news is about. Using the complete Wall Street Journal archive from 1990 to 2025, we construct monthly positive and negative sentiment indices for twelve economic topics and estimate topic-specific sentiment dynamics. Bad-news innovations generate larger cumulative responses than positive-sentiment innovations in every topic, indicating that negativity asymmetry is a broad feature of media sentiment. But the size of this asymmetry varies sharply across topics. The bad-minus-positive persistence gap is largest in security and human rights, firms and corporate strategy, health and public safety, and real estate and financial stability. Bad-news persistence is also sizable in data-rich topics such as financial markets, real estate, and corporate news, suggesting that frequent information arrival does not necessarily lead narratives to revert quickly. These findings show that aggregate sentiment indices mask substantial topic-level heterogeneity in the asymmetric dynamics of narratives, with potential implications for how persistent negative sentiment shapes expectations, asset prices, and real economic outcomes.
title: When Does Bad News Stick? Topic-Level Asymmetry in Narrative Dynamics
title_zh: 坏消息何时具有持久影响？叙事动态中的主题层面不对称性

abstract: We study how information about school quality affects families’ choices and how scaling up the intervention changes its impact. In a randomized trial in Chile, we offer families a short video and a personalized school report card before they enroll their children. Treated families choose schools with higher test scores and value added. Among families reached before enrollment, treated children score about 0.2 standard deviations higher in fourth grade, with positive but less precise estimates on later assessments. We embed the experimentally identified demand shift in a structural model of school choice and competition to study equilibrium effects at scale. Capacity constraints and centralized assignment attenuate the demand-side gains, but the same shift in demand strengthens schools’ incentives to improve quality, and the supply response roughly offsets the congestion effect. More generally, equilibrium scaling can alter experimental effects in either direction because congestion and endogenous quality responses work against each other. We use the model to guide the design of a follow-up cluster-randomized experiment, focusing on the tradeoff between precision and contamination from equilibrium spillovers.
title: Approximating the Equilibrium Effects of Informed School Choice
title_zh: 近似知情择校的均衡效应

abstract: We estimate the causal effects of a financial windfall on consumption, savings, and wage earnings using linked administrative data on a large sample of Canadian lottery winners. Using separate linkages of lottery winners to income tax records and credit bureau data, we estimate how lottery winnings affect consumption measured through credit card spending, savings through financial asset accumulation and debt repayment, and wage earnings from tax records. We then examine how these responses vary across the income distribution. We find that high-income individuals allocated a larger share of lottery winnings to savings and leisure, while low-income individuals spent a larger share on consumption. We illustrate the policy relevance of these heterogeneous responses through three applications: designing fiscal stimulus programs, evaluating a Universal Basic Income (UBI), and determining optimal top tax rates on wage earnings and savings.
title: Consumption, Savings, and Earnings Responses to Financial Windfalls
title_zh: 消费、储蓄与收入对意外之财的反应

abstract: We provide evidence on the extent to which food assistance affects spending on sugary items by studying the Pandemic Electronic Benefit Transfer (P-EBT) program, which provided funds to families of children who lost access to free and reduced-price school meals due to COVID-19 pandemic school closures. Leveraging state-level variation in the timing of P-EBT disbursements using a stacked difference-in-differences identification strategy with NielsenIQ Consumer Panel data, we find that P-EBT disbursement was associated with a 16-percent increase in weekly spending on sugary items among SNAP-eligible households with school-aged children. Notably, this increase exceeded the percentage increase in overall food spending for this group, suggesting that SNAP-eligible households with school-aged children allocated a disproportionately large share of their P-EBT-driven purchases toward sugary items relative to their pre-period baseline. We do not detect changes among households unlikely to have received P-EBT benefits or in placebo disbursement years.
title: Does Food Assistance Drive Spending on Sugary Foods? Evidence from the Pandemic Electronic Benefit Transfer Program

abstract: A critical tension in global governance is that trade agreements have evolved largely in isolation from climate policy. This paper shows that the two domains generate systematic cross-externalities: larger gains from trade are associated with greater climate externalities imposed on partners, while linking carbon taxes to trade agreements produces distributive externalities that undermine the balance of trade concessions. To address this tension, we present a framework to integrate harmonized carbon pricing into the WTO subject to institutional and political-feasibility constraints. We explore two linkage designs. The first is a centralized Climate Fund, where all members apply a common demand-side carbon tax and contribute a portion of the revenues to the fund, capped by fiscal constraints. The Fund then reallocates these contributions to balance the tax burden across countries, subject to informational constraints. Quantitative analysis shows that even a simple fund allocation rule can sustain a carbon price of $138 per ton of CO2, reducing global emissions by 54%. The main binding constraint is informational: knowing the precise incidence of the carbon tax across countries ex ante would raise the feasible price to $265. The second is a decentralized design without transfers. Each member meets a carbon tax revenue floor but retains full discretion over its mix of demand-side and supply-side taxes. Energy exporters choose supply-side taxes while energy importers opt for demand-side taxes. These choices organically balance the tax burden and yield a 47% reduction in global emissions, almost rivaling the centralized Climate Fund.

abstract: Alcohol use, transactional sex, and gambling carry significant health and economic consequences. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Kenya to assess whether these behaviors could be altered with a savings intervention that provided lottery-based interest, goal-setting support, and savings reminders. Over 24 months, the intervention increased formal savings and assets, financed primarily by lower spending on alcohol, transactional sex, and gambling. It also reduced hazardous drinking by 26 percent and intimate partner violence by 15 percent. HIV/STI incidence declined by 8 percent, though this was not statistically significant. Savings interventions can simultaneously boost financial security and change health behavior.
title: Crowding Out Temptation: Experimental Evidence on Savings and Health Behaviors in Kenya

abstract: Nonbank financial institutions are often seen as procyclical lenders, cutting credit more sharply than banks during stress, while bond markets can substitute for bank lending when credit supply contracts. This column brings these perspectives together and argues that this cyclicality depends on the function intermediaries perform. During banking crises, nonbank financial institutions contract syndicated lending relative to banks but expand corporate bond underwriting. For firms with potential access to bond markets, we find that relationships with nonbank underwriters can therefore help preserve market-based financing when bank credit is impaired.
title: Bonding through crises with nonbank financial institutions

abstract: This paper documents how foreign firms, inputs, and subsidies have shaped the development of Viet Nam’s solar panel industry. The analysis uses firmto-firm transaction data from Panjiva as well as firm-level data from the Viet Nam’s Enterprise Survey to trace solar panel value chains. It uncovers three key findings. First, parts and components from subsidizing countries are 30 percent cheaper than alternatives. Those from China, which provides the majority of solar inputs to Vietnamese producers, are cheapest. Foreign green subsidies may thus spill over across countries via value chains. Second, Chinese FDI firms dominate Viet Nam’s solar industry, accounting for 75% of exports and 50 percent of jobs, and they export solar panels that are 38 percent cheaper than those of other producers in Viet Nam. Third, local firms supplying parts and components to these Chinese FDI firms experience positive productivity gains. The findings show how Viet Nam’s solar boom emerged through deep integration into China’s subsidized supply chains.

abstract: U.S. states gave economic rights to married women between 1850 and 1920. Prior to this “women’s liberation,” the laws of coverture granted virtually unlimited power to husbands. Using the full count U.S. census and county-border pairs, we use an event-study analysis to show that rights reduced fertility. Additionally, women’s rights were not granted retroactively, allowing us to compare people married before and after the reforms, confirming our findings. Shifting bargaining power accounts for our results, with spousal disagreement over fertility plausibly due to maternal mortality risk. Women’s empowerment explains about 18% of the decline in fertility during the demographic transition.
title: Women’s Liberation and the Demographic Transition

abstract: The risk of ending up poor in old age is shaped at young ages and it is concentrated among women. Many countries attempt to mitigate this risk by redistributing income through lifetime-earnings-based pension systems. Using a quantitative model, we show that basing redistribution on annual rather than lifetime earnings generates much better labor market outcomes and leads to a more favorable distribution of old-age income. Such a system provides broad employment incentives, particularly for individuals at high risk of old-age poverty, and thereby addresses the underlying causes rather than merely the consequences of old-age poverty.
title: Women’s Labor Supply Incentives and Old-Age Income Redistribution
